<script data-origin="js/render/battle.js">
'use strict';
function showBattleIntro(name){$('battleFlashTitle').textContent=name;$('battleFlash').classList.remove('hidden');requestAnimationFrame(()=>$('battleFlash').classList.add('show'));setTimeout(()=>{$('battleFlash').classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>$('battleFlash').classList.add('hidden'),180)},650)}
function showBossCinematic(b,defeat=false){const box=$('bossCinematic');if(!box)return;$('bossEpithet').textContent=defeat?'BOSS DEFEATED':(b.epithet||'強敵');$('bossName').textContent=b.name;$('bossQuote').textContent=defeat?'――戦場の空気が、静かにほどけていく。':(b.quote||'');box.classList.toggle('defeat',defeat);box.classList.remove('hidden');requestAnimationFrame(()=>box.classList.add('show'));setTimeout(()=>{box.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>box.classList.add('hidden'),220)},defeat?1050:1450)}
function showEncounterCinematic(epithet,name,quote){const box=$('bossCinematic');if(!box)return;$('bossEpithet').textContent=epithet;$('bossName').textContent=name;$('bossQuote').textContent=quote||'';box.classList.remove('defeat','hidden');requestAnimationFrame(()=>box.classList.add('show'));setTimeout(()=>{box.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>box.classList.add('hidden'),220)},1250)}
function enemyVisualType(e){
 const n=String(e?.name||''),f=String(e?.faction||'');
 if(e?.art==='bandit')return'human-bandit';
 if(e?.human||f==='empire'||f==='kingdom'||/(兵|隊長|ヴァルク|ゼニス|斥候)/.test(n))return f==='empire'?'human-empire':'human-bandit';
 if(/コウモリ/.test(n))return'bat-swarm';
 if(/ムカデ|甲虫|ネズミ/.test(n))return'cave-crawler';
 if(/角猪|灰角獣/.test(n))return'horned-beast';
 return'beast-wolf'
}
function enemyVisualMarkup(type){
 if(type==='human-bandit'||type==='human-empire')return'<i class="enemy-part bandit-shadow"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-leg l"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-leg r"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-body"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-arm l"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-arm r"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-head"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-hair"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-eye"></i><i class="enemy-part bandit-blade"></i>';
 if(type==='bat-swarm')return'<i class="enemy-part bat b1"></i><i class="enemy-part bat b2"></i><i class="enemy-part bat b3"></i><i class="enemy-part bat b4"></i><i class="enemy-part bat-shadow"></i>';
 if(type==='cave-crawler')return'<i class="enemy-part crawler-shadow"></i><i class="enemy-part crawler-seg s1"></i><i class="enemy-part crawler-seg s2"></i><i class="enemy-part crawler-seg s3"></i><i class="enemy-part crawler-seg s4"></i><i class="enemy-part crawler-head"></i><i class="enemy-part crawler-eye"></i>';
 if(type==='horned-beast')return'<i class="enemy-part beast-shadow"></i><i class="enemy-part beast-leg l"></i><i class="enemy-part beast-leg r"></i><i class="enemy-part beast-body"></i><i class="enemy-part beast-head"></i><i class="enemy-part beast-horn a"></i><i class="enemy-part beast-horn b"></i><i class="enemy-part beast-eye"></i>';
 return'<i class="enemy-part wolf-shadow"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-tail"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-leg back"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-leg front"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-body"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-neck"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-head"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-ear a"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-ear b"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-muzzle"></i><i class="enemy-part wolf-eye"></i>'
}
function renderBattleStage(){const b=state.battle;if(!b)return;const e=GC.CommercialTactics.target(b)||livingEnemies()[0]||b.enemies[0];if(!e)return;$('stageEnemyName').textContent=e.name;$('stageEnemyState').textContent=enemyMood(e);const enemyStage=$('enemyVisual');if(enemyStage)enemyStage.classList.toggle('staggered',!!e.staggered);$('stageHpText').textContent=`${Math.max(0,e.hp)} / ${e.maxHp}`;$('stageHpBar').style.width=`${Math.max(0,e.hp/e.maxHp*100)}%`;if(e.morale==null){$('stageMoraleText').textContent='—';$('stageMoraleBar').style.width='0%'}else{$('stageMoraleText').textContent=`${Math.max(0,e.morale)} / ${e.maxMorale}`;$('stageMoraleBar').style.width=`${Math.max(0,e.morale/e.maxMorale*100)}%`}const stage=$('battleStage'),terrain=state.battleReturn?.map||state.map;
 if(stage){stage.dataset.terrain=terrain==='cave'?'cave':terrain==='road'?'road':'other';stage.dataset.boss=b.id==='boss'?'true':'false'}
 const enemyArt=$('enemyArt'),enemyType=enemyVisualType(e);
 if(enemyArt.className!=='enemy-art '+enemyType){enemyArt.className='enemy-art '+enemyType;enemyArt.innerHTML=enemyVisualMarkup(enemyType)}
 const line=$('partyBattleLine');
 const ids=activeRouteParty().map(p=>p.id).join(',');
 if(line.dataset.party!==ids||line.children.length!==activeRouteParty().length){
  line.dataset.party=ids;
  line.innerHTML=activeRouteParty().map((p,i)=>`<div id="battleHero${i}" data-hero="${p.id}" class="battle-hero sprite" style="left:${i*56}px"><span class="battle-hero-fallback" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></span><span class="battle-sprite-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="battle-frame-image" src="assets/characters/${p.id}/${p.id}_idle.png" data-idle="assets/characters/${p.id}/${p.id}_idle.png" data-walk="assets/characters/${p.id}/${p.id}_walk.png" alt="" draggable="false"></span></div>`).join('')
 }
 // Source paths belong to the HTML root, never to css/game.css. Keep a
 // deliberately visible fallback when any atlas is missing or invalid.
 activeRouteParty().forEach((p,i)=>{
  const node=$('battleHero'+i);if(!node)return;
  node.classList.toggle('active',i===b.actor);node.classList.toggle('down',p.hp<=0);
  const img=node.querySelector('.battle-frame-image');if(!img)return;
  if(!img.dataset.checking){
   img.dataset.checking='1';
   img.onload=()=>{const ok=img.naturalWidth>=192&&img.naturalHeight>=192;
    node.classList.toggle('asset-ready',ok);
    if(!ok)node.classList.add('asset-missing');
   };
   img.onerror=()=>{node.classList.remove('asset-ready');node.classList.add('asset-missing')};
   if(img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0)img.onload();
  }
 });

}
function battlePop(text,kind='damage'){const layer=$('damageLayer');if(!layer)return;const n=document.createElement('div');n.className='damage-pop '+(kind==='morale'?'morale':kind==='heal'?'heal':kind==='ally'?'ally':'');n.textContent=text;n.style.marginLeft=`${Math.floor(Math.random()*15)-7}px`;n.style.marginTop=`${Math.floor(Math.random()*9)-4}px`;layer.appendChild(n);setTimeout(()=>n.remove(),760)}
function battleImpact(actorIndex,damage=0,moraleLoss=0,kind='physical',done=()=>{}){state.locked=true;const hero=$('battleHero'+actorIndex),enemy=$('enemyVisual'),stage=$('battleStage'),flash=$('battleImpactFlash');if(hero){hero.classList.add('strike');
 const sprite=hero.querySelector('.battle-frame-image');
 if(sprite&&hero.classList.contains('asset-ready')){
  sprite.src=sprite.dataset.walk;
 }
}if(kind==='magic')sfx('magic');else if(kind==='heal')sfx('heal');else sfx('slash');setTimeout(()=>{if(damage>0){if(enemy){enemy.classList.remove('hit');void enemy.offsetWidth;enemy.classList.add('hit')}if(stage){stage.classList.remove('impact-shake');void stage.offsetWidth;stage.classList.add('impact-shake')}if(flash){flash.classList.remove('show');void flash.offsetWidth;flash.classList.add('show')}battlePop(String(damage));sfx('hit');$('battlePanel').classList.add('hit-stop');setTimeout(()=>$('battlePanel').classList.remove('hit-stop'),82)}if(moraleLoss>0)battlePop('士気 -'+moraleLoss,'morale');renderBattleStage()},135);setTimeout(()=>{if(hero){hero.classList.remove('strike');
 const sprite=hero.querySelector('.battle-frame-image');
 if(sprite&&hero.classList.contains('asset-ready'))sprite.src=sprite.dataset.idle;
 }state.locked=false;done()},420)}
function renderBattle(){const b=state.battle;if(!b)return;$('turnLabel').textContent='TURN '+b.turn;renderBattleStage();$('enemyCards').innerHTML=b.enemies.map((e,i)=>{const faction=e.faction||battles[b.id].faction||'wild';const label=e.human?'人間':faction==='empire'?'レグノア帝国軍':faction==='kingdom'?'アルディナ王国軍':'野生';return `<div class="card enemy faction-${faction} ${e.hp<=0?'down':''} ${GC.CommercialTactics.index(b)===i?'targeted':''}"><div class="enemy-row"><div class="enemy-info"><div class="enemy-faction">${label}</div><div class="party-head"><strong>${e.name}</strong><span>HP ${e.hp}/${e.maxHp}</span></div></div></div></div>`}).join('');$('partyCards').innerHTML=activeRouteParty().map((p,i)=>`<div class="card ally ${p.hp<=0?'down':''} ${i===b.actor?'acting':''}"><div class="party-head"><strong>${p.name} <small>Lv.${p.level}</small></strong><span>${i===b.actor?'▶ 行動中':''}</span></div><div class="party-sub">HP ${p.hp}/${p.maxHp}　MP ${p.mp}/${p.maxMp}</div><div class="battle-hp-meter" aria-label="HP ${p.hp} / ${p.maxHp}"><span style="width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,p.hp/p.maxHp*100))}%"></span></div><div class="battle-mp-meter" aria-label="MP ${p.mp} / ${p.maxMp}"><span style="width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,p.mp/p.maxMp*100))}%"></span></div></div>`).join('');const a=currentActor();if(a.hp<=0){nextActor();return}let acts=(BATTLE_LOADOUTS[a.id]||[]).map(id=>{const sk=SKILLS[id],mp=sk?.mp||0;return{id,label:sk.label+(mp?` · ${mp}MP`:''),disabled:!GC.CommercialTactics.actionAvailable(id,a)}});const e=GC.CommercialTactics.target(b)||livingEnemies()[0];if(e?.human)acts.push({id:'persuade',label:'降伏を促す',disabled:false});const herb=state.inventory['薬草']||0,mana=state.inventory['魔力草']||0,food=state.inventory['携帯食']||0;acts.push({id:'item',label:`薬草 ×${herb}`,disabled:!GC.CommercialTactics.actionAvailable('item',a)},{id:'manaItem',label:`魔力草 ×${mana}`,disabled:!GC.CommercialTactics.actionAvailable('manaItem',a)},{id:'foodItem',label:`携帯食 ×${food}`,disabled:!GC.CommercialTactics.actionAvailable('foodItem',a)});$('battleActions').innerHTML=acts.map(x=>`<button data-battle="${x.id}" ${x.disabled||state.locked?'disabled':''}>${x.label}</button>`).join('');document.querySelectorAll('[data-battle]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(btn.disabled||state.locked)return;sfx('select');battleAction(btn.dataset.battle)}));
 const choices=GC.CommercialTactics.options(b).filter(v=>v.alive),picker=$('battleTargets');
 picker.innerHTML=choices.length>1?'<span class="target-picker-label">狙う敵</span>'+choices.map(v=>'<button type="button" class="target-choice '+(v.selected?'selected':'')+'" data-target-index="'+v.index+'" aria-pressed="'+v.selected+'">'+v.name+' · HP '+v.hp+'/'+v.maxHp+'</button>').join(''):'';
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-target-index]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(state.locked||!state.battle)return;
  if(GC.CommercialTactics.choose(state.battle,Number(btn.dataset.targetIndex))){sfx('select');renderBattle()}
 }));
 const tip=$('battleHelp');if(tip)tip.textContent=(state.locked?'演出中：行動入力を受け付けていません。　':'')+GC.CommercialTactics.hint(a,b)+
  (b.counterWindow&&b.counterWindow.turn===b.turn&&b.counterWindow.enemy.hp>0?
   '　反撃の好機：予告攻撃を庇った！ 次の攻撃に追加5ダメージ（1回限り）。':'');
 const preview=$('battleForecast');if(preview){
  const plan=checkpointEnemyIntent(b);
  preview.classList.toggle('hidden',!plan);
  preview.textContent=plan?'敵の予兆　'+plan.target.name+'への攻撃：'+plan.note:'';
 }

 renderHud()}
function battleLog(t){const box=$('battleLog');box.innerHTML+=`<div>${t}</div>`;box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight}
function showLevelUpSummary(list,onClose){if(!list.length){onClose();return}const box=$('levelUpPanel');$('levelUpList').innerHTML=list.map(u=>`<div class="level-card"><div class="level-card-head"><strong>${u.name}</strong><span>Lv.${u.level}</span></div><div class="level-stat-grid"><span>最大HP <b>+${u.hp}</b></span><span>最大MP <b>+${u.mp}</b></span><span>攻撃 <b>+${u.atk}</b></span><span>防御 <b>+${u.def}</b></span><span>素早さ <b>+${u.spd}</b></span></div></div>`).join('');box.classList.remove('hidden');const close=()=>{box.classList.add('hidden');$('levelUpContinue').onclick=null;onClose()};$('levelUpContinue').onclick=close}
function showBattleResult(outcome,gold,exp,done,quick=false){const box=$('battleResult');if(!box){done();return}const surrender=outcome==='surrender';$('battleResultKicker').textContent=surrender?'BATTLE END':'VICTORY';$('battleResultTitle').textContent=surrender?'降伏':'勝利';$('battleResultDetail').textContent=`${gold}G　/　EXP ${exp}`;box.classList.remove('hidden');requestAnimationFrame(()=>box.classList.add('show'));if(!quick)sfx('victory');setTimeout(()=>{box.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>{box.classList.add('hidden');done()},quick?100:170)},quick?340:860)}
GC.Render=GC.Render||{};GC.Render.Battle={showBattleIntro,showBossCinematic,showEncounterCinematic,renderBattleStage,battlePop,battleImpact,renderBattle,battleLog,showLevelUpSummary,showBattleResult};

</script>
<script data-origin="js/systems/battle.js">
'use strict';
function captureBattleReturn(){state.battleReturn={map:state.map,x:state.x,y:state.y,dir:state.dir,trail:state.trail.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]])}}
function restoreBattleReturn(){const r=state.battleReturn;if(!r||!maps[r.map]){state.battleReturn=null;return}state.map=r.map;state.x=r.x;state.y=r.y;state.dir=r.dir;state.trail=Array.isArray(r.trail)?r.trail:[[r.x+1,r.y],[r.x+2,r.y],[r.x+3,r.y]];state.battleReturn=null;VISUAL.map=null;setMusic(mapMusicTheme(state.map))}
function startSymbolEncounter(objectId,battleId){if(state.battle||objectCleared(objectId))return false;state.symbolEncounter={objectId,battleId,map:state.map};captureBattleReturn();startBattle(battleId,true);return true}
function startBattle(id,fromSymbol=false){if(!$('dialogueBox').classList.contains('hidden'))closeDialogue(false);GC.Log?.info('Battle Start',{id,map:state.map,fromSymbol});if(!state.battleReturn)captureBattleReturn();if(!fromSymbol)state.symbolEncounter=null;state.locked=true;const ev=$('enemyVisual');if(ev)ev.classList.remove('hit','shake','surrender');const bdef=battles[id];GC.CommercialTactics?.reset?.();state.battle={id,turn:1,actor:Math.max(0,activeRouteParty().findIndex(p=>p.hp>0)),comboTarget:null,comboActor:null,counterWindow:null,enemies:bdef.enemies.map(e=>({...e,morale:e.morale??null,maxMorale:e.maxMorale??e.morale??null})),log:[],outcome:null,
 metrics:{startedAt:Date.now(),actions:{},rounds:0,enemyAttacks:0,damageTaken:0,guardedAllies:0,
  openingHp:activeRouteParty().reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.hp,0),
  openingMp:activeRouteParty().reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.mp,0)}};
 setMusic(id==='boss'?'boss':'battle');$('battleLog').innerHTML='';$('battleTitle').textContent=bdef.name;$('battlePanel').classList.remove('hidden');if(bdef.boss)showBossCinematic(bdef,false);else if(!bdef.random)showBattleIntro(bdef.name);battleLog(`―― ${bdef.name}との戦闘！`);if(id==='boss'&&state.events.choices['early.fortShield']==='studied')battleLog('古砦の傷だらけの盾を思い出す。角の踏み込みにはトリトンの「崩し」が使えそうだ。');renderBattle();const openingBattle=state.battle;setTimeout(()=>{if(state.battle!==openingBattle)return;state.locked=false;renderBattle()},bdef.boss?1480:bdef.random?180:680)}
function livingEnemies(){return state.battle.enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0)}
function currentActor(){return activeRouteParty()[state.battle.actor]}
function enemyMood(e){if(e.staggered>0)return'体勢崩れ・次の行動不能';if(e.morale==null)return'野生';const r=e.morale/e.maxMorale;if(r<=.2)return'崩れかけ';if(r<=.5)return'動揺';return'戦意あり'}
function applyMoraleDamage(e,amount){if(e.morale==null)return 0;const d=Math.max(0,Math.min(e.morale,Math.floor(amount)));e.morale-=d;return d}
function battleSurrender(){const b=state.battle,e=b.enemies[0];state.locked=true;b.outcome='surrender';if($('enemyVisual'))$('enemyVisual').classList.add('surrender');battleLog(`${e.name}は武器を捨て、戦意を失った。`);setTimeout(()=>battleWin('surrender'),420)}

function damageFormula(atk,def,bonus=0,variance=RPG_RULES.damage.variance){return Math.max(RPG_RULES.damage.minimum,Math.floor(atk+bonus-def*RPG_RULES.damage.defenseScale)+Math.floor(Math.random()*(variance+1)))}
// Guarding the announced target creates exactly one short counter opportunity.
// Stored on the active encounter only: no skill unlock, no button, no save migration.
function applyGuardOpening(b,e,damage){
 const opportunity=b?.counterWindow;
 if(!opportunity||damage<=0||e.hp<=0||opportunity.enemy!==e||opportunity.turn!==b.turn)return 0;
 b.counterWindow=null;
 const extra=Math.min(5,e.hp);
 if(extra){
  e.hp-=extra;
  const m=applyMoraleDamage(e,3);
  battleLog('反撃の好機！ 守りから生まれた隙に追加'+extra+'ダメージ。'+(m?' 士気-'+m+'。':''));
  sfx('rally');
 }
 return extra
}
function battleAction(type){if(state.locked||!state.battle)return;const b=state.battle,a=currentActor(),e=GC.CommercialTactics?.target?.(b)||livingEnemies()[0];if(!e)return;if(!GC.CommercialTactics.actionAvailable(type,a))return;const actorIndex=b.actor;let d=0,moraleLoss=0,visual='physical',acted=true;
 if(type==='attack'){d=damageFormula(a.atk+(a.buff||0),e.def);if(GC.Dev?.settings?.instantVictory)d=e.hp;e.hp=Math.max(0,e.hp-d);moraleLoss=applyMoraleDamage(e,d*.42);battleLog(`${a.name}の剣撃！ ${e.name}に${d}ダメージ。`)}
 else if(type==='staffSophie'||type==='staffMargaret'){d=damageFormula(a.atk,e.def,SKILLS[type].power);e.hp=Math.max(0,e.hp-d);moraleLoss=applyMoraleDamage(e,d*.35);battleLog(`${a.name}の杖撃！ ${e.name}に${d}ダメージ。`)}
 else if(type==='guard'){a.guard=true;visual='heal';battleLog(activeRouteParty().length===1?`${a.name}は防御の構えを取った。`:`${a.name}は仲間を庇う構えを取った。`);sfx('guard')}
 else if(type==='rally'){activeRouteParty().forEach(p=>p.buff=(p.buff||0)+SKILLS.rally.value);visual='heal';battleLog(`${a.name}の号令！ 全員の攻撃力が一時的に上がる。`);battleLog('カレン「全員、顔を上げて！　私たちなら進める！」');sfx('rally')}
 else if(type==='heavy'){d=damageFormula(a.atk+(a.buff||0),e.def,SKILLS.heavy.power);e.hp=Math.max(0,e.hp-d);moraleLoss=applyMoraleDamage(e,d*.55);battleLog(`${a.name}の強撃！ ${e.name}に${d}ダメージ。`);if(b.id==='wolves'&&b.turn===1&&state.events.choices['early.renPractice']==='strike')battleLog('レンとの稽古で見せた踏み込み！　でも、まだ狼の反撃が来る。')}
 else if(type==='break'){d=damageFormula(a.atk,e.def,SKILLS.break.power);e.hp=Math.max(0,e.hp-d);e.def=Math.max(1,e.def-SKILLS.break.defDown);moraleLoss=applyMoraleDamage(e,10+d*.45);battleLog(`${a.name}が防御を崩した。${d}ダメージ、防御低下。`);
  // A visible tactical payoff for the first optional dungeon. One interruption
  // per tough enemy: no extra command button or repetitive stun-lock.
  if(d>0&&e.hp>0&&!e.staggerUsed&&['crawler','boss'].includes(b.id)){
   e.staggered=1;e.staggerUsed=true;
   battleLog('体勢崩し成功！ '+e.name+'の次の攻撃を阻止した。');
   if(b.id==='boss'&&state.events.choices['early.fortShield']==='studied'&&!b.fortShieldRecalled){
    b.fortShieldRecalled=true;
    battleLog('トリトン「古砦の盾で見た踏み込みだ！　いま、止めた！」');
   }
   sfx('guard')
  }battleLog('トリトン「今だ、隙ができた！」')}
 else if(type==='fire'||type==='ice'){const sk=SKILLS[type];if(a.mp<sk.mp){battleLog('MPが足りない。');return}a.mp-=sk.mp;d=sk.power+Math.floor(Math.random()*(sk.variance+1));e.hp=Math.max(0,e.hp-d);if(type==='ice')e.atk=Math.max(4,e.atk-SKILLS.ice.atkDown);moraleLoss=applyMoraleDamage(e,d*.3);visual='magic';battleLog(`${a.name}の${type==='fire'?'火球':'氷槍'}！ ${e.name}に${d}ダメージ。`);if(type==='ice'){
  battleLog('マーガレット「動きを鈍らせた。次の攻撃に備えて」');
  if(b.id==='boss'&&state.events.choices['early.fortShield']==='studied'&&!b.fortShieldRecalled){
   b.fortShieldRecalled=true;
   battleLog('マーガレット「盾の傷から読んだ通り。突進する前の足を冷やせたわ」');
  }
 }}
 else if(type==='heal'||type==='prayer'){const sk=SKILLS[type];if(a.mp<sk.mp){battleLog('MPが足りない。');return}a.mp-=sk.mp;visual='heal';if(type==='heal'){const t=[...activeRouteParty()].filter(x=>x.hp>0).sort((x,y)=>x.hp/x.maxHp-y.hp/y.maxHp)[0]||a;const before=t.hp;t.hp=Math.min(t.maxHp,t.hp+sk.power);const healed=t.hp-before;battleLog(`${a.name}の治癒。${t.name}のHPが${healed}回復。`);battlePop('+'+healed,'heal')}else{let total=0;activeRouteParty().forEach(p=>{if(p.hp>0){const before=p.hp;p.hp=Math.min(p.maxHp,p.hp+sk.power);total+=p.hp-before}});battleLog(`${a.name}の祈り。全体でHPが${total}回復。`);battleLog('ソフィ「まだ立てます。みんな、無理しないで！」')}}
 else if(type==='persuade'){const missing=1-e.hp/e.maxHp,m=12+Math.floor(missing*22)+(a.id==='sophie'?6:a.id==='margaret'?3:0);moraleLoss=applyMoraleDamage(e,m);visual='heal';battleLog(`${a.name}は武器を下ろすよう呼びかけた。${e.name}の士気が${moraleLoss}下がった。`)}
 else if(type==='manaItem'){if((state.inventory['魔力草']||0)<=0){battleLog('魔力草がない。');return}state.inventory['魔力草']--;const t=[...activeRouteParty()].filter(x=>x.hp>0).sort((x,y)=>x.mp/x.maxMp-y.mp/y.maxMp)[0]||a;const before=t.mp;t.mp=Math.min(t.maxMp,t.mp+14);visual='heal';battleLog(`${a.name}は魔力草を使った。${t.name}のMPが${t.mp-before}回復。`)}
 else if(type==='item'){if((state.inventory['薬草']||0)<=0){battleLog('薬草がない。');return}state.inventory['薬草']--;const t=[...activeRouteParty()].filter(x=>x.hp>0).sort((x,y)=>x.hp/x.maxHp-y.hp/y.maxHp)[0]||a;const before=t.hp;t.hp=Math.min(t.maxHp,t.hp+22);visual='heal';battleLog(`${a.name}は薬草を使った。${t.name}のHPが${t.hp-before}回復。`)}
 else if(type==='foodItem'){if((state.inventory['携帯食']||0)<=0){battleLog('携帯食がない。');return}state.inventory['携帯食']--;a.hp=Math.min(a.maxHp,a.hp+12);a.mp=Math.min(a.maxMp,a.mp+6);visual='heal';battleLog(`${a.name}は携帯食を口にした。HPとMPが少し回復。`)}else acted=false;
 if(!acted)return;
 // Short-lived local playtest counters. Never leave state.battle and never
 // persist in schema-23 Save (serializeSave explicitly nulls battle).
 if(b.metrics)b.metrics.actions[type]=(b.metrics.actions[type]||0)+1;
 if(d>0)applyGuardOpening(b,e,d);
 // Same-target coordination rewards consecutive different hero attacks.
 // Stored only in the transient encounter; no save schema or boss stats change.
 if(d>0&&e.hp>0&&e.hp<e.maxHp){
  if(b.comboTarget===e&&b.comboActor!==a.id&&b.comboActor!=null){
   const extra=Math.min(3,e.hp);
   if(extra>0){e.hp-=extra;battleLog('連携成功！ '+a.name+'が仲間の作った隙を突き、追加'+extra+'ダメージ。');sfx('rally')}
  }
  b.comboTarget=e;b.comboActor=a.id;
 }else{b.comboTarget=null;b.comboActor=null}
 renderBattleStage();battleImpact(actorIndex,d,moraleLoss,visual,()=>{if(e.hp<=0){if(!livingEnemies().length)return battleWin();return nextActor()}if(e.morale!=null&&e.morale<=0)return battleSurrender();nextActor()})}
// Announced *before* player actions for route-specific checkpoint encounters.
// Uses the same prediction for the HUD and the real incoming strike.
function checkpointEnemyIntent(b){
 if(!b)return null;
 const patterns={
  kingdomEvacuation:{order:['sophie','triton'],bonus:2,note:'避難路の支援役を狙う。カレンの庇うで守れる。'},
  kingdomOrders:{order:['karen','margaret'],bonus:3,note:'前衛を崩す強打。庇うか事前に回復を。'},
  empireProtect:{order:['sophie','karen'],bonus:1,note:'捕虜の治療担当を牽制。庇うで援護できる。'},
  empireAdvance:{order:['triton','karen'],bonus:3,note:'追撃を止める前衛へ集中攻撃。回復と防御を計画しよう。'}
 };
 // One gentle, clear defensive decision in the first mandatory encounter.
 // Later wolf turns keep the standard AI to avoid a scripted-feeling entire fight.
 if(b.id==='crawler'&&b.turn===1){
  const living=activeRouteParty().filter(p=>p.hp>0);
  if(!living.length)return null;
  return {target:living.find(p=>p.id==='triton')||living[0],bonus:0,
   note:'硬い殻はトリトンの崩しで弱体化。マーガレットの氷槍なら攻撃も鈍る。'}
 }
 if(b.id==='wolves'&&b.turn===1){
  const living=activeRouteParty().filter(p=>p.hp>0);
  if(!living.length)return null;
  const target=living.find(p=>p.id==='sophie')||living[0];
  const scouted=state.events?.choices?.['early.wolfScout']==='read';
  return {target,bonus:0,scouted,note:scouted
   ?'足跡から後衛への回り込みを予測。カレンの庇うで防げる（偵察で被害軽減）。'
   :'後衛への回り込みに警戒。カレンの庇うで守れる。'}
 }
 // Important bosses introduce a readable, once-only threat rather than
 // just inflating HP. Only the first round is scripted; later rounds retain
 // the original AI and the existing guarded-counter opportunity.
 if((b.id==='vanguardCaptain'||b.id==='zenithEncounter')&&b.turn===1){
  const living=activeRouteParty().filter(p=>p.hp>0);
  if(!living.length)return null;
  const targetId=b.id==='vanguardCaptain'?'margaret':'sophie';
  const target=living.find(p=>p.id===targetId)||living[0];
  return {target,bonus:0,note:b.id==='vanguardCaptain'
   ?'ヴァルクは詠唱中のマーガレットを狙う。カレンの庇う、または氷槍で被害を抑えよう。'
   :'ゼニスは回復役のソフィを見据えている。庇うか氷槍で守りつつ、崩しで防御を下げよう。'};
 }
 const pattern=patterns[b.id];if(!pattern)return null;
 const living=activeRouteParty().filter(p=>p.hp>0);if(!living.length)return null;
 const preferred=pattern.order[(Math.max(1,b.turn)-1)%pattern.order.length];
 const target=living.find(p=>p.id===preferred)||living.slice().sort((a,c)=>a.hp/a.maxHp-c.hp/c.maxHp)[0];
 return {target,bonus:pattern.bonus,note:pattern.note}
}
function nextActor(){
 const b=state.battle;if(!b)return;
 const team=activeRouteParty();
 let next=b.actor+1;
 // Knocked-out allies remain in the saved party but cannot accept commands.
 // Skip them instead of indefinitely waiting on a disabled combat button.
 while(next<team.length&&team[next].hp<=0)next++;
 if(next>=team.length){b.actor=0;b.comboTarget=null;b.comboActor=null;enemyTurn()}
 else{b.actor=next;renderBattle()}
}
// Prevent 3 quick consecutive hits on one ally in a multi-enemy round.
function selectEnemyTarget(alive,b,random=Math.random){
 const alternatives=alive.filter(p=>p.id!==b.lastTarget);
 const pool=b.targetStreak>=2&&alternatives.length?alternatives:alive;
 const picked=pool[Math.min(pool.length-1,Math.floor(random()*pool.length))];
 b.targetStreak=picked.id===b.lastTarget?(b.targetStreak||0)+1:1;
 b.lastTarget=picked.id;
 return picked
}
function enemyTurn(){const b=state.battle,bd=battles[b.id],foes=livingEnemies().slice();state.locked=true;b.counterWindow=null;let i=0;const step=()=>{if(i>=foes.length){activeRouteParty().forEach(p=>{p.guard=false;if(p.buff)p.buff=Math.max(0,p.buff-1)});if(activeRouteParty().every(p=>p.hp<=0))return battleLose();b.turn++;b.actor=activeRouteParty().findIndex(p=>p.hp>0);if(b.actor<0)return battleLose();state.locked=false;renderBattle();return}const e=foes[i++];
 if(e.staggered>0){e.staggered--;battleLog(e.name+'は体勢を崩して行動できない！');renderBattle();setTimeout(step,220);return}
 if(bd.boss&&e.phase===1&&e.hp<e.maxHp*.65){e.phase=2;e.atk+=2;battleLog(`<strong class="boss-phase">PHASE II — ${bd.phase2||'攻勢が変化した'}</strong>`)}else if(bd.boss&&e.phase===2&&e.hp<e.maxHp*.3){e.phase=3;e.atk+=3;e.def+=1;battleLog(`<strong class="boss-phase">FINAL PHASE — ${bd.phase3||'全力を解放した'}</strong>`)}const alive=activeRouteParty().filter(p=>p.hp>0);if(!alive.length)return battleLose();// Telegraph tactical danger while preserving original fair target-selection rules.
 if(bd.boss&&e.phase>=2)battleLog('警戒：'+e.name+'が攻勢を強めている。防御と回復を確認しよう。');
 const focus=checkpointEnemyIntent(b);const originallyTargeted=focus?.target||selectEnemyTarget(alive,b);const t=GC.CommercialTactics?.protect?.(activeRouteParty(),originallyTargeted)||originallyTargeted;let d=damageFormula(e.atk+(focus?.bonus||0),t.def);if(focus?.scouted)d=Math.max(1,d-2);if(t.guard)d=Math.max(1,Math.floor(d/2));if(GC.Dev?.settings?.invincible)d=0;t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-d);if(b.metrics){b.metrics.enemyAttacks++;b.metrics.damageTaken+=d;if(t!==originallyTargeted&&t.guard)b.metrics.guardedAllies++}
 if(t!==originallyTargeted)battleLog(`${t.name}が${originallyTargeted.name}を庇った！ ${e.name}の攻撃を引き受け、${d}ダメージ。`);
 if(b.id==='wolves'&&b.turn===1&&t!==originallyTargeted&&t.guard&&state.events.choices['early.renPractice']==='guard')battleLog('レンとの稽古を思い出した！　カレンの一歩が、本当にソフィを守った。');if(t!==originallyTargeted&&t.guard&&focus){
  b.counterWindow={enemy:e,turn:b.turn+1};
  battleLog('守りの連携！ 敵に隙が生まれた。次の味方ターンの攻撃で反撃できる。');
 }
 if(t!==originallyTargeted)sfx('guard');else battleLog(`${e.name}の攻撃。${t.name}に${d}ダメージ。`);const ev=$('enemyVisual');if(ev){ev.classList.remove('shake');void ev.offsetWidth;ev.classList.add('shake')}battlePop('-'+d,'ally');sfx('hit');renderBattle();setTimeout(step,360)};step()}
// Replace ONE existing closing line of the eight-line first-wolf scene,
// only after a real guarded interception or a genuine footprint inspection.
// Do not lengthen the mandatory scene or pretend guarding worked when it did not.
function openingWolfReaction(def,metrics,scouted){
 if(def?.id!=='alpha.road.wolfVictory'||!def.lines?.length)return def;
 let closing=null;
 if((metrics?.guardedAllies||0)>0)closing=
  {speaker:'カレン',text:'「ソフィを守れた。怖かったけど……次も声を聞き逃さない」'};
 else if(scouted)closing=
  {speaker:'マーガレット',text:'「足跡を読めても、三人が動いてくれなきゃ意味がなかった。……次も一緒に考えましょう」'};
 if(!closing)return def;
 return {...def,lines:[...def.lines.slice(0,-1),closing]};
}
function battleWin(outcome='defeat'){const b=state.battle,id=b.id,bd=battles[id],r=bd.reward;GC.Log?.info('Battle End',{id,outcome});
 // Ren only celebrates a real guarded interception if the fight recorded one.
 // Otherwise the child remembers a victory without falsely claiming a shield
 // saved Sophie. This single optional acknowledgement is schema-23 safe.
 if(id==='wolves'&&state.events.choices['early.renPractice']&&!state.events.choices['early.renWolfOutcome'])
  state.events.choices['early.renWolfOutcome']=(b.metrics?.guardedAllies||0)>0?'protected':'won';
 if(b.metrics)GC.Log?.info('Local Battle Balance',{
  id,map:state.map,outcome,playerResult:'win',rounds:b.turn,
  elapsedMs:Math.max(0,Date.now()-b.metrics.startedAt),
  actions:{...b.metrics.actions},enemyAttacks:b.metrics.enemyAttacks,
  damageTaken:b.metrics.damageTaken,
  openingHp:b.metrics.openingHp,remainingHp:activeRouteParty().reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.hp,0),
  openingMp:b.metrics.openingMp,remainingMp:activeRouteParty().reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.mp,0),
  heroes:activeRouteParty().map(p=>p.id)
 });const scriptedEvent=findTriggeredEvent('battleWin',id,{outcome,map:state.map});const aftermath=openingWolfReaction(scriptedEvent,b.metrics,state.events.choices['early.wolfScout']==='read');if(scriptedEvent)applyEventEffects(scriptedEvent,{outcome,map:state.map});if(bd.boss)showBossCinematic(bd,true);const rewardGold=outcome==='surrender'?Math.floor(r.gold*.65):r.gold;state.gold+=rewardGold;const levelMessages=[];activeRouteParty().forEach(p=>{p.exp+=r.exp;const ups=applyLevelUps(p);for(const up of ups)levelMessages.push({name:p.name,...up})});battleLog(`${outcome==='surrender'?'戦闘終了':'勝利'}！ ${rewardGold}G、経験値${r.exp}を獲得。`);for(const u of levelMessages)battleLog(`<strong class="level-up">LEVEL UP! ${u.name} Lv.${u.level}　HP+${u.hp} MP+${u.mp} 攻撃+${u.atk} 防御+${u.def} 素早さ+${u.spd}</strong>`);if(r.drop&&Math.random()<r.drop.chance){state.inventory[r.drop.item]=(state.inventory[r.drop.item]||0)+1;battleLog(`${r.drop.item}を1個手に入れた。`)}
 const finalRouteBattle={
  kingdomEvacuation:{route:'kingdom',choice:'evacuate',context:'避難路を確保するため帝国の封鎖兵を退けた。'},
  kingdomOrders:{route:'kingdom',choice:'orders',context:'帝国本陣の前衛警戒隊を退け、交渉の道を開いた。'},
  empireProtect:{route:'empire',choice:'protect',context:'降伏者を護送する王国兵の抵抗を収めた。'},
  empireAdvance:{route:'empire',choice:'advance',context:'追撃命令を届ける王国の伝令隊を止めた。'}
 }[id];
 if(finalRouteBattle){
  const key='final.route.'+finalRouteBattle.route+'.checkpoint';
  if(state.finalChoice===finalRouteBattle.route&&
     state.events?.choices?.['route.companions.'+finalRouteBattle.route]===finalRouteBattle.choice){
   completeEvent(key,true);
   addJournal(finalRouteBattle.context+(outcome==='surrender'?'相手は降伏して武器を下ろした。':'戦闘不能となった相手の死亡は確定していない。'));
  }
 }
 if(id==='ashcrownCheckpoint'){
  completeEvent('ashcrownCheckpointCleared',true);
  addJournal(outcome==='surrender'
   ?'灰冠への道を塞いだ守備兵は武器を捨てた。カレンは追撃せず、先へ進んだ。'
   :'灰冠への道を塞いだ守備兵を退けた。倒れた相手の生死は確認できておらず、殺害と決めつけない。');
 }
 if(id==='roadBandit'){markDefeated('bandit',true);addJournal(outcome==='surrender'?'街道のならず者を降伏させ、命を奪わず戦闘を終えた。':'街道のならず者との戦闘に勝利した。')}
 if(id==='bats'){markDefeated('bats',true);addJournal('古砦跡の入口付近に巣食うコウモリを追い払った。')}
 if(id==='crawler'){markDefeated('crawler',true);addJournal('古砦跡の奥で石殻ムカデを退けた。')}
 if(id==='boss'){markDefeated('boss',true);state.objective='古砦跡の北出口を目指す';addJournal('古砦跡の主・灰角獣を倒し、北側の鉄柵が開いた。')}
 if(id==='zenithEncounter'){completeEvent('metZenith',true);state.objective='北側の帰還路から王国へ戻る';addJournal('ゼニスとの対決を経て、王国の歴史的主張に根拠があることと、現在の住民を追い出す正当性は別問題だという認識を共有した。');draw()}
 const won=id,wasRandom=!!battles[id].random;resetEncounterCounter();const ev=$('enemyVisual');if(ev&&outcome!=='surrender')ev.classList.add('defeated');state.battle=null;state.locked=true;const finishBattle=()=>{restoreBattleReturn();state.symbolEncounter=null;$('battlePanel').classList.add('hidden');if(ev)ev.classList.remove('defeated');renderHud();draw();const afterLevel=()=>{state.locked=false;if(scriptedEvent)playEventDialogue(aftermath);
 else if(['kingdomEvacuation','kingdomOrders','empireProtect','empireAdvance'].includes(won)){
  saySequence([
   {speaker:'ナレーション',text:outcome==='surrender'?'相手は武器を置き、進路を譲った。':'敵兵は戦う力を失い、進路が開いた。'},
   {speaker:'カレン',text:'「先へ進もう。私たちは勝敗だけを伝えに来たんじゃない」'},
   {speaker:'ナレーション',text:'指揮官へ話しかけ、交渉を続けよう。'}
  ])
 }

 else if(won==='ashcrownCheckpoint')saySequence([
 {speaker:'ナレーション',text:outcome==='surrender'?'守備兵は武器を下ろし、道から退いた。':'守備兵は戦う力を失い、道を塞ぐことができなくなった。'},
 {speaker:'カレン',text:'「この先で何を失うのか、もう誰も教えてくれない」'},
 {speaker:'ナレーション',text:'北へ進むと、灰冠の道が続く。準備ができたら北端へ向かおう。'}
 ]);
 else if(won==='roadBandit'&&outcome!=='surrender')saySequence([{speaker:'ナレーション',text:'武器を落としたならず者は、もう抵抗できない。'},{speaker:'ソフィ',text:'「この人はもう戦えません」'}],()=>say('カレン','「命を奪う理由が、まだある？」',[{label:'武器を取り上げて見逃す',fn:()=>{recordGrayCrownMoralChoice('roadBandit','spare');say('トリトン','「武器は置いていけ。二度と旅人を襲うな」')}},{label:'抵抗できない相手を殺す',fn:()=>{recordGrayCrownMoralChoice('roadBandit','kill');saySequence([{speaker:'ナレーション',text:'誰も止める言葉を間に合わせられなかった。'},{speaker:'ソフィ',text:'「……なぜ。もう戦えなかったのに」'},{speaker:'マーガレット',text:'「これは戦いじゃない。私たちが選んだことよ」'}])}}]));else if(won==='roadBandit')saySequence(outcome==='surrender'?[{speaker:'街道のならず者',text:'「……もういい。武器は捨てる。だから殺すな」'},{speaker:'カレン',text:'「追いかけない。食べ物が必要なら、行商人に仕事を頼めないか聞いてみて」'},{speaker:'トリトン',text:'「甘いと思うけど……倒す以外で終われるなら、その方がいい」'}]:[{speaker:'ナレーション',text:'ならず者は地面に倒れ、しばらく動かなかった。さっきまでの獣との戦いとは、後味がまるで違う。'},{speaker:'ソフィ',text:'「……人と戦うのは、やっぱり嫌です」'},{speaker:'マーガレット',text:'「今後はもっと増える。だからこそ、倒す以外の終わらせ方も考えないと」'}]);else if(won==='boss')say('マーガレット','「奥の鉄柵が壊れた。これで北側へ抜けられるはずよ」');else if(won==='crawler')say('ソフィ','「この先にも何かいます。傷が深いなら、いったん村まで戻るのもありですよ」');else if(won==='zenithEncounter')saySequence([{speaker:'ゼニス',text:'「……十分だ。資料を持って行け」'},{speaker:'マーガレット',text:'「敵なのに、止めないの？」'},{speaker:'ゼニス',text:'「敵だからこそだ。王国側にも、事実を見た人間が必要になる。私は帝国の利益のためにそう判断する」'},{speaker:'カレン',text:'「最後まで合理的なんだね」'},{speaker:'ゼニス',text:'「君たちは最後まで感情的だ。それで助かった人間もいる。互いに長所ということにしておこう」'}]);else if(wasRandom){canvas.focus()}else say('カレン','「みんな無事？ よし。先へ進もう」')};showLevelUpSummary(levelMessages,afterLevel)};setTimeout(()=>showBattleResult(outcome,rewardGold,r.exp,finishBattle,wasRandom),bd.boss?720:wasRandom?60:180)}
function battleLose(){const b=state.battle;GC.Log?.warn('Battle Lose',{id:b?.id,map:state.map});
 if(b?.metrics)GC.Log?.info('Local Battle Balance',{
  id:b.id,map:state.map,outcome:'defeat',playerResult:'loss',rounds:b.turn,
  elapsedMs:Math.max(0,Date.now()-b.metrics.startedAt),
  actions:{...b.metrics.actions},enemyAttacks:b.metrics.enemyAttacks,
  damageTaken:b.metrics.damageTaken,openingHp:b.metrics.openingHp,
  remainingHp:activeRouteParty().reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.hp,0),
  openingMp:b.metrics.openingMp,remainingMp:activeRouteParty().reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.mp,0),
  heroes:activeRouteParty().map(p=>p.id)
 });battleLog(activeRouteParty().length===1?'カレンは力尽きた……。':'仲間たちは力尽きた……。');const wasMap=state.battleReturn?.map||state.map;state.battleReturn=null;state.symbolEncounter=null;activeRouteParty().forEach(p=>{p.hp=p.maxHp;p.mp=p.maxMp;p.guard=false;p.buff=0});state.battle=null;state.locked=true;setTimeout(()=>{$('battlePanel').classList.add('hidden');if(wasMap==='cave')setMap('cave',12,13,'up',[[12,14],[11,14],[10,14]]);else if(maps[wasMap]&&!INTERIOR_MAPS.includes(wasMap))setMap(wasMap,11,13,'up',[[12,13],[13,13],[14,13]]);else setMap('road',11,13,'up',[[12,13],[13,13],[14,13]]);state.locked=false;say('ナレーション',activeRouteParty().length===1?'カレンは退き、立て直した。HP・MPは回復。経験値は失わない。':'仲間たちは安全な場所へ退き、立て直した。HP・MPは回復。経験値は失わない。');renderHud()},700)}
function showEnding(){enterCapital(true)}
GC.Battle={selectEnemyTarget,captureBattleReturn,restoreBattleReturn,startSymbolEncounter,startBattle,livingEnemies,currentActor,enemyMood,applyMoraleDamage,battleSurrender,battleAction,nextActor,enemyTurn,battleWin,battleLose};

</script>
<script data-origin="js/core/save.js">
'use strict';
const SAVE_KEY='gray-crown-vslice-save-v1';
const SAVE_BACKUP_KEY=SAVE_KEY+'-backup';
// A separate, player-recoverable checkpoint before a fresh adventure. Never
// use the rotating save backup for this: two subsequent saves replace it.
const SAVE_ARCHIVE_KEY=SAVE_KEY+'-previous-adventure';
const SAVE_QUARANTINE_KEY=SAVE_KEY+'-corrupt-raw-backups';
const SAVE_SCHEMA=23;
function safeNumber(v,fallback,min=-Infinity,max=Infinity){return Number.isFinite(v)?Math.max(min,Math.min(max,v)):fallback}
function nearestSafeTile(mapId,x,y,saveState=state){
 const m=maps[mapId];if(!m)return[11,13];
 const passThrough=new Set(['gate','exit','northExit','southExit','roadSign','milestone','banner','rations']);
 // A collected chest/forage spot is no longer solid. Crucially, load validation
 // must inspect the *loaded* world's flags, not the old session still in memory.
 const cleared=o=>{
  const id=o.id,world=saveState?.world||{};
  const treasure=world.treasures||{},defeated=world.defeatedSymbols||{},switches=world.switches||{};
  // Mirror overworld objectCleared, but read the SAVE BEING LOADED, not the
  // previous in-memory session. Open gates and defeated bosses are traversable
  // even if they still exist in the map's immutable object list.
  if(TREASURE_DEFS[id]&&treasure[id]===true)return true;
  if(['wolf','bandit','bats','crawler','boss','scavengerWolves','imperialPatrol'].includes(id)&&defeated[id]===true)return true;
  if(id==='innerGate'&&switches.leverWest===true&&switches.leverEast===true)return true;
  if((id==='fortGate'||id==='fortGateRight')&&switches.fortGateOpen===true)return true;
  if(['ashCache','frontierCache','empireCache','imperialCache','yukiCache','elsiaCache'].includes(id)&&treasure[id]===true)return true;
  return false
 };
 const blockedTile=(xx,yy)=>{
  const t=tileAt(mapId,xx,yy);
  if(['T','H','S','W','R','K','Z'].includes(t))return true;
  if(m.npcs.some(n=>n.x===xx&&n.y===yy))return true;
  if(m.objects.some(o=>o.x===xx&&o.y===yy&&!passThrough.has(o.id)&&!cleared(o)))return true;
  return false
 };
 x=Math.max(0,Math.min(COLS-1,Math.floor(x)));
 y=Math.max(0,Math.min(ROWS-1,Math.floor(y)));
 if(!blockedTile(x,y))return[x,y];
 for(let r=1;r<12;r++)for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++){
  if(Math.abs(dx)!==r&&Math.abs(dy)!==r)continue;
  const xx=x+dx,yy=y+dy;
  if(xx>=0&&yy>=0&&xx<COLS&&yy<ROWS&&!blockedTile(xx,yy))return[xx,yy]
 }
 return INTERIOR_MAPS.includes(mapId)?[11,11]:[11,13]
}
function mergeStructuredState(fresh,src){
 const loaded=createGameState();
 for(const key of ['map','x','y','dir','trail','locked','encounterSteps','nextEncounterAt','interiorReturn','journal','inventory','gold'])if(src[key]!==undefined)loaded[key]=src[key];
 loaded.story={...fresh.story,...(src.story||{})};
 loaded.quests={...fresh.quests,...(src.quests||{}),main:{...fresh.quests.main,...(src.quests?.main||{})},active:{...fresh.quests.active,...(src.quests?.active||{})},completed:{...fresh.quests.completed,...(src.quests?.completed||{})}};
 loaded.world={...fresh.world,...(src.world||{}),visited:{...fresh.world.visited,...(src.world?.visited||{})},switches:{...fresh.world.switches,...(src.world?.switches||{})},defeatedSymbols:{...fresh.world.defeatedSymbols,...(src.world?.defeatedSymbols||{})},recoveryUses:{...fresh.world.recoveryUses,...(src.world?.recoveryUses||src.recoveryUses||{})},treasures:{...fresh.world.treasures,...(src.world?.treasures||src.treasures||{})},shortcuts:{...fresh.world.shortcuts,...(src.world?.shortcuts||src.shortcuts||{})},finalChoice:src.world?.finalChoice??src.finalChoice??fresh.world.finalChoice};
 loaded.events={...fresh.events,...(src.events||{}),completed:{...fresh.events.completed,...(src.events?.completed||{})},choices:{...fresh.events.choices,...(src.events?.choices||{})}};
 loaded.party=(src.party||fresh.party).map((p,i)=>({...fresh.party[i],...p}));
 loaded.inventory={...fresh.inventory,...(src.inventory||{})};
 importLegacyFlags(loaded,src.flags||{});
 if(src.flags?.chest1)loaded.world.treasures.chest1=true;if(src.flags?.chest2)loaded.world.treasures.chest2=true;
 if(src.flags?.talkedWithKaren||src.flags?.appointed)loaded.events.completed['alpha.village.appointment']=true;
 if(src.flags?.capitalCeremony)loaded.events.completed['alpha.capital.ceremony']=true;
 if(src.flags?.capitalFirstNight)loaded.events.completed['alpha.capital.whiteStagNight']=true;
 if(src.flags?.alphaHourComplete)loaded.events.completed['alpha.complete']=true;
 loaded.story.stage=inferStoryStage(src);
 if(!src.story?.chapter&&src.chapter)loaded.story.chapter=src.chapter;
 if(!src.story?.objective&&src.objective)loaded.story.objective=src.objective;
 syncMainQuest(loaded);
 return attachStateCompatibility(loaded)
}
function validateLoadedState(loaded,fresh=createGameState()){
 loaded.gold=safeNumber(loaded.gold,fresh.gold,0,999999);loaded.x=safeNumber(loaded.x,11,0,COLS-1);loaded.y=safeNumber(loaded.y,13,0,ROWS-1);
 loaded.party=(loaded.party||fresh.party).slice(0,4).map((p,i)=>{const f=fresh.party[i]||fresh.party[0];return{...f,...p,level:safeNumber(p.level,f.level,1,MAX_LEVEL),exp:safeNumber(p.exp,f.exp,0,9999999),maxHp:safeNumber(p.maxHp,f.maxHp,1,9999),maxMp:safeNumber(p.maxMp,f.maxMp,0,9999),atk:safeNumber(p.atk,f.atk,1,999),def:safeNumber(p.def,f.def,0,999),spd:safeNumber(p.spd,f.spd,1,999),hp:safeNumber(p.hp,f.maxHp,0,safeNumber(p.maxHp,f.maxHp,1,9999)),mp:safeNumber(p.mp,f.maxMp,0,safeNumber(p.maxMp,f.maxMp,0,9999))}});
 for(const k of Object.keys(loaded.inventory||{}))loaded.inventory[k]=Math.floor(safeNumber(loaded.inventory[k],0,0,999));
 for(const k of Object.keys(loaded.world.recoveryUses||{}))loaded.world.recoveryUses[k]=Math.floor(safeNumber(loaded.world.recoveryUses[k],0,0,99));
 loaded.map=maps[loaded.map]?loaded.map:'village';if(loaded.map==='relayvillage'){loaded.map='borderland';loaded.x=11;loaded.y=5}if(loaded.map==='ravine'){loaded.map='watchfort';loaded.x=11;loaded.y=8}
 loaded.world.visited[loaded.map]=true;loaded.battle=null;loaded.battleReturn=null;loaded.symbolEncounter=null;loaded.locked=false;
 loaded.encounterSteps=Number.isFinite(loaded.encounterSteps)?loaded.encounterSteps:0;loaded.nextEncounterAt=Number.isFinite(loaded.nextEncounterAt)?loaded.nextEncounterAt:rollEncounterThreshold(loaded.map);
 const pos=nearestSafeTile(loaded.map,loaded.x,loaded.y,loaded);loaded.x=pos[0];loaded.y=pos[1];if(!Array.isArray(loaded.trail)||loaded.trail.length<3)loaded.trail=[[loaded.x+1,loaded.y],[loaded.x+2,loaded.y],[loaded.x+3,loaded.y]];
 return attachStateCompatibility(loaded)
}
function migrateLoaded(raw){const fresh=createGameState(),src=JSON.parse(raw);const loaded=mergeStructuredState(fresh,src);loaded.party.forEach(p=>applyLevelUps(p));const reconciled=reconcileStoryState(loaded);if(reconciled.repairs.length)GC.Log?.warn('Save story state repaired during migration',reconciled);loaded.schema=SAVE_SCHEMA;return validateLoadedState(loaded,fresh)}
function transientUiActive(){return !!state.battle||!!state.locked||($('dialogueBox')&&!$('dialogueBox').classList.contains('hidden'))||($('levelUpPanel')&&!$('levelUpPanel').classList.contains('hidden'))||($('battleResult')&&!$('battleResult').classList.contains('hidden'))}
function canPersistNow(mode='save'){
 if(typeof ALPHA_SESSION!=='undefined'&&!ALPHA_SESSION.started)return mode==='load';
 if(mode==='save'&&GC.Dev?.isStateTainted?.())return false;
 return !transientUiActive()
}
function serializeSave(){return JSON.stringify({...state,schema:SAVE_SCHEMA,locked:false,battle:null,battleReturn:null,symbolEncounter:null})}
function isUsableSavedAdventure(raw){
 if(typeof raw!=='string'||!raw)return false;
 try{
  const saved=JSON.parse(raw);
  // Prevent a random parseable JSON or corrupted partial save from
  // silently becoming a clean, empty "archive" after migration.
  const canonical=createGameState().party;
  if(!saved||typeof saved!=='object'||Array.isArray(saved)||
    !Number.isInteger(saved.schema)||saved.schema<1||saved.schema>SAVE_SCHEMA||
    !Object.hasOwn(maps,saved.map)||!saved.story||typeof saved.story.stage!=='string'||
    !Array.isArray(saved.party)||saved.party.length!==canonical.length||
    !saved.party.every((hero,i)=>hero&&hero.id===canonical[i].id&&
      hero.name===canonical[i].name&&hero.job===canonical[i].job)||
    !saved.world||typeof saved.world!=='object'||Array.isArray(saved.world)||
    !saved.inventory||typeof saved.inventory!=='object'||Array.isArray(saved.inventory)||
    Object.keys(saved.inventory).some(k=>!Object.hasOwn(ITEM_DEFS,k)))return false;
  migrateLoaded(raw); // Migration follows strict player-owned identity checks.
  return true
 }catch(_){return false}
}
function save(silent=false){
 if(!canPersistNow('save')){if(!silent&&!GC.Dev?.isStateTainted?.()&&!state.battle&&$('dialogueBox')?.classList.contains('hidden'))say('システム','イベントや戦闘の途中ではセーブできません。操作可能な場所でセーブしてください。');else if(!silent&&GC.Dev?.isStateTainted?.())say('システム','Developer操作後の状態は通常セーブできません。Debug Snapshotを使用してください。');return false}
 try{
  const payload=serializeSave(),prev=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
  // Never rotate a corrupted primary over a usable previous checkpoint.
  const backup=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY);
  try{
   if(isUsableSavedAdventure(prev))localStorage.setItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,prev);
   else if(!isUsableSavedAdventure(backup))localStorage.setItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,payload);
   localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,payload)
  }catch(writeError){
   // A failed primary write must not leave the older backup overwritten.
   // Preserve both original slots as a single logical transaction.
   try{
    if(prev===null)localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);
    else localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,prev);
    if(backup===null)localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY);
    else localStorage.setItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,backup)
   }catch(rollbackError){GC.Log?.error('Save rollback failed',{error:String(rollbackError)})}
   throw writeError
  }
  GC.Log?.info('Save',{map:state.map,x:state.x,y:state.y,stage:state.story.stage});if(!silent)say('システム','セーブしました。');return true}catch(e){GC.Log?.error('Save failed',{error:String(e)});if(!silent)say('システム','セーブに失敗しました。ブラウザの保存領域を確認してください。');return false}}
function clearTransientPanels(){for(const id of ['battlePanel','levelUpPanel','battleResult','battleFlash','bossCinematic','chapterCard'])$(id)?.classList.add('hidden');if($('dialogueBox')&&!$('dialogueBox').classList.contains('hidden'))closeDialogue(false)}
function load(silent=false){
 if(!canPersistNow('load')){if(!silent&&$('dialogueBox')?.classList.contains('hidden'))say('システム','イベントや戦闘の途中ではロードできません。操作可能な場所でロードしてください。');return false}
 const primary=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY),backup=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY);if(!primary&&!backup){if(!silent)say('システム','セーブデータがありません。');return false}let recovered=false,next;
 // Migration can fill missing fields from defaults. Before migrating, ensure
 // a partially truncated but parseable JSON is not mistaken for a fresh game.
 if(!isUsableSavedAdventure(primary)){
  if(!isUsableSavedAdventure(backup)){
   GC.Log?.error('No structurally usable save or backup');
   if(!silent)say('システム','セーブデータとバックアップの両方を読み込めませんでした。');
   return false
  }
  recovered=true;next=migrateLoaded(backup)
 }else next=migrateLoaded(primary);
 clearTransientPanels();replaceState(next);VISUAL.map=null;setMusic(mapMusicTheme(state.map));renderHud();draw();GC.Dev?.clearTaint?.();GC.Log?.info('Load',{map:state.map,x:state.x,y:state.y,stage:state.story.stage,recovered});if(!silent&&typeof ALPHA_SESSION!=='undefined'&&!ALPHA_SESSION.started)hideTitle();if(!silent)say('システム',recovered?'通常セーブが壊れていたため、バックアップから復旧しました。':'ロードしました。');return true}

// Portable JSON is necessary for player ZIP/file:// releases: browser
// localStorage belongs to the specific browser/origin, not the game folder.
function exportPortableSaveText(){
 if(!save(true))return null;
 return localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)
}
function downloadPortableSave(){
 const raw=exportPortableSaveText();
 if(!raw){say('システム','安全にセーブを書き出せません。操作可能な場所で再試行してください。');return false}
 try{
  const blob=new Blob([raw],{type:'application/json;charset=utf-8'});
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url;a.download='GrayCrown_Save_v23_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();
  setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),3000);
  say('システム','セーブを書き出しました。別のPCで遊ぶ時は「セーブを読み込む」を使ってください。');
  return true
 }catch(e){GC.Log?.error('Portable save export failed',{error:String(e)});
  say('システム','セーブの書き出しに失敗しました。ブラウザのダウンロード設定を確認してください。');return false}
}
function importPortableSaveText(raw){
 // Strict structural gate before migration: a generic JSON is not a valid save.
 // Supports real earlier-version saves, but never silently imports future schema.
 if(typeof raw!=='string'||raw.length>2*1024*1024) return false;
 if(!canPersistNow('load'))return false;
 let parsed,loaded;
 try{
  parsed=JSON.parse(raw);
  const canonical=createGameState().party;
  const expected=['karen','triton','sophie','margaret'];
  if(!parsed||!Number.isInteger(parsed.schema)||parsed.schema<1||parsed.schema>SAVE_SCHEMA||
     !parsed.story||typeof parsed.story!=='object'||!parsed.world||typeof parsed.world!=='object'||
     !parsed.inventory||typeof parsed.inventory!=='object'||Array.isArray(parsed.inventory)||
     Object.keys(parsed.inventory).some(id=>!Object.hasOwn(ITEM_DEFS,id))||
     !Array.isArray(parsed.party)||parsed.party.length!==4||
     !parsed.party.every((p,i)=>p&&p.id===expected[i]&&p.name===canonical[i].name&&p.job===canonical[i].job)||
     !maps[parsed.map])return false;
  loaded=migrateLoaded(raw);
 }catch(e){GC.Log?.warn('Portable save validation failed',{error:String(e)});return false}
 const primary=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY),backup=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY);
 try{
  // Persist the migrated *validated* schema, never raw untrusted file text.
  const payload=JSON.stringify({...loaded,schema:SAVE_SCHEMA,locked:false,battle:null,
    battleReturn:null,symbolEncounter:null});
  if(isUsableSavedAdventure(primary))localStorage.setItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,primary);
  else if(!isUsableSavedAdventure(backup))localStorage.setItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,payload);
  localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,payload);
  if(!load(true))throw new Error('Imported save could not be loaded');
  updateTitleContinue();
  return true
 }catch(e){
  GC.Log?.error('Portable save import failed',{error:String(e)});
  try{
   if(primary===null)localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);else localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,primary);
   if(backup===null)localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY);else localStorage.setItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,backup)
  }catch(_){}
  return false
 }
}
async function readPortableSaveFile(file){
 if(!file||file.size>2*1024*1024){
  say('システム','2MB以下のGray Crownセーブファイル（.json）を選んでください。');return false
 }
 if(!canPersistNow('load')){
  say('システム','戦闘やイベントの途中ではセーブを読み込めません。');return false
 }
 const priorExists=!!localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
 if(!confirm(priorExists?'現在のセーブをバックアップして、選んだセーブデータへ切り替えますか？':
  '選んだセーブデータを読み込みますか？'))return false;
 let ok=false;
 try{ok=importPortableSaveText(await file.text())}
 catch(e){GC.Log?.error('Portable save read failed',{error:String(e)})}
 say('システム',ok?(priorExists?'外部セーブを読み込みました。元のセーブはバックアップに保存されています。':
  '外部セーブを読み込みました。'):'セーブの読み込みに失敗しました。形式やデータを確認してください。');
 return ok
}

function hasArchivedAdventure(){try{return isUsableSavedAdventure(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_ARCHIVE_KEY))}catch(_){return false}}
function hasUsableStoredAdventure(){
 try{return isUsableSavedAdventure(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY))||
  isUsableSavedAdventure(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY))}
 catch(_){return false}
}
function hasQuarantinedSaves(){
 try{return !!localStorage.getItem(SAVE_QUARANTINE_KEY)}catch(_){return false}
}
function quarantineCorruptSavesBeforeNewGame(){
 try{
  const primary=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY),backup=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY);
  // Never classify a future-version save as disposable; quarantine stores
  // exact original bytes so a later game can still recover those records.
  if(!primary&&!backup)return true;
  if(isUsableSavedAdventure(primary)||isUsableSavedAdventure(backup))return false;
  const existing=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_QUARANTINE_KEY);
  const record={savedAt:new Date().toISOString(),primary,backup};
  const old=existing?JSON.parse(existing):[];
  if(!Array.isArray(old))return false;
  const entryAlreadyStored=old.some(x=>x?.primary===primary&&x?.backup===backup);
  if(!entryAlreadyStored)old.push(record);
  const payload=JSON.stringify(old);
  localStorage.setItem(SAVE_QUARANTINE_KEY,payload);
  return localStorage.getItem(SAVE_QUARANTINE_KEY)===payload
 }catch(e){
  GC.Log?.error('Corrupt save quarantine failed',{error:String(e)});
  return false
 }
}
function downloadQuarantinedSaves(){
 try{
  const raw=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_QUARANTINE_KEY);
  if(!raw)return false;
  const blob=new Blob([raw],{type:'application/json;charset=utf-8'});
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),link=document.createElement('a');
  link.href=url;link.download='GrayCrown_RawSaveRecovery_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.json';
  document.body.appendChild(link);link.click();link.remove();
  setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),3000);
  say('システム','破損した元の保存データを、変更せず取り出しました。データの復旧を試す場合に保管してください。');
  return true
 }catch(e){GC.Log?.error('Quarantine export failed',{error:String(e)});return false}
}

function archiveBeforeNewGame(){
 let candidate;
 try{
  const main=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
  const backup=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY);
  if(!main&&!backup)return true;
  // Corrupted primary may coexist with a valid backup: archive the playable
  // adventure, not broken bytes. If neither works, stop and keep existing data.
  candidate=isUsableSavedAdventure(main)?main:isUsableSavedAdventure(backup)?backup:null;
  if(!candidate)return false;
  // A new game must not begin if the player's preceding save cannot be
  // preserved. The special archive survives later manual saves.
  localStorage.setItem(SAVE_ARCHIVE_KEY,candidate);
  return localStorage.getItem(SAVE_ARCHIVE_KEY)===candidate
 }catch(e){
  GC.Log?.error('Previous adventure archive failed',{error:String(e)});
  return false
 }
}
function restoreArchivedAdventure(){
 if(!canPersistNow('load'))return false;
 const raw=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_ARCHIVE_KEY);
 if(!raw)return false;
 if(!confirm('保管していた以前の冒険を復旧しますか？ 現在のセーブはバックアップへ移します。'))return false;
 const ok=importPortableSaveText(raw);
 say('システム',ok?'以前の冒険を復旧しました。現在のセーブはバックアップに残しています。':'以前の冒険を復旧できませんでした。現在のセーブには変更していません。');
 return ok
}
function restart(){
 if(typeof startNewGameSafely!=='function')return false;
 // A brand-new unsaved session still deserves an explicit warning.
 // Otherwise switching from the menu can erase hours of unsaved play.
 let persisted=false;
 try{persisted=!!(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)||localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY))}
 catch(e){GC.Log?.error('Restart storage check failed',{error:String(e)});return false}
 if(!persisted&&!confirm('保存していない現在の冒険を破棄して、最初から始めますか？'))return false;
 return startNewGameSafely()
}
GC.Save={SAVE_KEY,SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,SAVE_ARCHIVE_KEY,SAVE_QUARANTINE_KEY,SAVE_SCHEMA,hasArchivedAdventure,hasUsableStoredAdventure,hasQuarantinedSaves,quarantineCorruptSavesBeforeNewGame,downloadQuarantinedSaves,archiveBeforeNewGame,restoreArchivedAdventure,save,load,restart,migrateLoaded,serializeSave,validateLoadedState,nearestSafeTile,transientUiActive,canPersistNow,clearTransientPanels,exportPortableSaveText,downloadPortableSave,importPortableSaveText,readPortableSaveFile};

</script>
<script data-origin="js/systems/validation.js">
'use strict';
function pushIssue(list,code,message,context={}){list.push({code,message,context})}
function duplicates(values){const seen=new Set(),dups=new Set();for(const v of values){if(seen.has(v))dups.add(v);seen.add(v)}return [...dups]}
function validateData(){
 const errors=[],warnings=[];const blocked=new Set(['T','H','S','W','R','K','Z']);
 for(const [mapId,m] of Object.entries(maps)){
  if(!Array.isArray(m.tiles)||m.tiles.length!==ROWS||m.tiles.some(r=>typeof r!=='string'||r.length!==COLS))pushIssue(errors,'MAP_DIMENSIONS',`Map ${mapId} has invalid dimensions`,{mapId});
  for(const id of duplicates((m.npcs||[]).map(n=>n.id)))pushIssue(errors,'NPC_DUPLICATE_IN_MAP',`Duplicate NPC id ${id} in ${mapId}`,{mapId,id});
  for(const id of duplicates((m.objects||[]).map(o=>o.id)))pushIssue(errors,'OBJECT_DUPLICATE_IN_MAP',`Duplicate object id ${id} in ${mapId}`,{mapId,id});
  for(const n of m.npcs||[]){if(n.x<0||n.y<0||n.x>=COLS||n.y>=ROWS)pushIssue(errors,'NPC_OUT_OF_BOUNDS',`NPC ${n.id} is outside ${mapId}`,{mapId,id:n.id,x:n.x,y:n.y})}
  for(const o of m.objects||[]){if(o.x<0||o.y<0||o.x>=COLS||o.y>=ROWS)pushIssue(errors,'OBJECT_OUT_OF_BOUNDS',`Object ${o.id} is outside ${mapId}`,{mapId,id:o.id,x:o.x,y:o.y})}
 }
 const eventIds=EVENT_DEFS.map(e=>e.id);for(const id of duplicates(eventIds))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_DUPLICATE',`Duplicate event id ${id}`,{id});
 const eventStateIds=new Set(eventIds);for(const e of EVENT_DEFS)for(const fx of e.effects||[])if(fx.type==='completeEvent'&&fx.id)eventStateIds.add(fx.id);
 for(const e of EVENT_DEFS){
  const tr=e.trigger||{};if(tr.map&&!maps[tr.map])pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_MAP',`Event ${e.id} references missing map ${tr.map}`,{id:e.id,map:tr.map});
  if(tr.map&&tr.type==='npc'&&!maps[tr.map]?.npcs?.some(n=>n.id===tr.target))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_NPC',`Event ${e.id} references missing NPC ${tr.target}`,{id:e.id});
  if(tr.map&&tr.type==='object'&&!maps[tr.map]?.objects?.some(o=>o.id===tr.target))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_OBJECT',`Event ${e.id} references missing object ${tr.target}`,{id:e.id});
  const complete=new Set((e.when||[]).filter(c=>c.eventComplete).map(c=>c.eventComplete)),incomplete=new Set((e.when||[]).filter(c=>c.eventIncomplete).map(c=>c.eventIncomplete));for(const id of complete)if(incomplete.has(id))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_IMPOSSIBLE_CONDITION',`Event ${e.id} requires ${id} both complete and incomplete`,{id:e.id,condition:id});
  for(const id of [...complete,...incomplete])if(!eventStateIds.has(id))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_EVENT_REF',`Event ${e.id} references unknown event state ${id}`,{id:e.id,condition:id});
  for(const fx of e.effects||[]){if(fx.type==='startBattle'&&!battles[fx.id])pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_BATTLE',`Event ${e.id} starts missing battle ${fx.id}`,{id:e.id,battle:fx.id});if(fx.type==='openTreasure'&&!TREASURE_DEFS[fx.id])pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_TREASURE',`Event ${e.id} opens missing treasure ${fx.id}`,{id:e.id,treasure:fx.id});if(fx.type==='advanceStory'&&!STORY_ORDER.includes(fx.stage))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_STORY_EFFECT',`Event ${e.id} advances to unknown story stage ${fx.stage}`,{id:e.id,stage:fx.stage})}
  for(const c of e.when||[])if(c.storyIs&&!STORY_ORDER.includes(c.storyIs)||c.storyAtLeast&&!STORY_ORDER.includes(c.storyAtLeast))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_BAD_STORY_STAGE',`Event ${e.id} references unknown story stage`,{id:e.id,condition:c});
 }
 for(const [id,t] of Object.entries(MAP_TRANSITIONS)){if(!maps[t.from])pushIssue(errors,'TRANSITION_BAD_FROM',`Transition ${id} missing from map ${t.from}`,{id});if(!maps[t.to])pushIssue(errors,'TRANSITION_BAD_TO',`Transition ${id} missing to map ${t.to}`,{id});if(maps[t.to]){if(t.x<0||t.y<0||t.x>=COLS||t.y>=ROWS)pushIssue(errors,'TRANSITION_OUT_OF_BOUNDS',`Transition ${id} spawn is outside ${t.to}`,{id});else if(blocked.has(maps[t.to].tiles[t.y][t.x]))pushIssue(warnings,'TRANSITION_BLOCKED_TILE',`Transition ${id} spawns on blocking tile`,{id,map:t.to,x:t.x,y:t.y})}}
 for(const [id,def] of Object.entries(TREASURE_DEFS)){if(!maps[def.map])pushIssue(errors,'TREASURE_BAD_MAP',`Treasure ${id} references missing map`,{id,map:def.map});if(!ITEM_DEFS[def.item])pushIssue(errors,'TREASURE_BAD_ITEM',`Treasure ${id} references missing item ${def.item}`,{id,item:def.item});if(maps[def.map]&&!maps[def.map].objects.some(o=>o.id===id))pushIssue(warnings,'TREASURE_OBJECT_MISSING',`Treasure ${id} has no matching map object`,{id,map:def.map})}
 for(const [mapId,f] of Object.entries(MAP_FEATURES)){const m=maps[mapId];if(!m){pushIssue(errors,'FEATURE_BAD_MAP',`Map features reference missing map ${mapId}`,{mapId});continue}for(const id of f.npcs||[])if(!m.npcs.some(n=>n.id===id))pushIssue(errors,'FEATURE_BAD_NPC',`Feature ${mapId} references missing NPC ${id}`,{mapId,id});for(const id of f.optional||[])if(!m.objects.some(o=>o.id===id))pushIssue(errors,'FEATURE_BAD_OBJECT',`Feature ${mapId} references missing object ${id}`,{mapId,id});for(const id of f.treasures||[])if(!TREASURE_DEFS[id])pushIssue(errors,'FEATURE_BAD_TREASURE',`Feature ${mapId} references missing treasure ${id}`,{mapId,id});for(const id of f.shortcuts||[]){if(!SHORTCUT_DEFS[id])pushIssue(errors,'FEATURE_BAD_SHORTCUT',`Feature ${mapId} references missing shortcut ${id}`,{mapId,id});else if(SHORTCUT_DEFS[id].map!==mapId)pushIssue(errors,'FEATURE_SHORTCUT_WRONG_MAP',`Shortcut ${id} belongs to ${SHORTCUT_DEFS[id].map}, not ${mapId}`,{mapId,id})}}
 for(const [id,def] of Object.entries(SHORTCUT_DEFS))if(!maps[def.map])pushIssue(errors,'SHORTCUT_BAD_MAP',`Shortcut ${id} references missing map ${def.map}`,{id,map:def.map});
 for(const [owner,loadout] of Object.entries(BATTLE_LOADOUTS)){if(!partyBase.some(p=>p.id===owner))pushIssue(errors,'LOADOUT_BAD_OWNER',`Loadout owner ${owner} is missing`,{owner});for(const skill of loadout)if(!SKILLS[skill])pushIssue(errors,'LOADOUT_BAD_SKILL',`Loadout ${owner} references missing skill ${skill}`,{owner,skill})}
 for(const [id,skill] of Object.entries(SKILLS)){if(skill.id!==id)pushIssue(errors,'SKILL_ID_MISMATCH',`Skill key ${id} has id ${skill.id}`,{id});if(skill.owner&&!partyBase.some(p=>p.id===skill.owner))pushIssue(errors,'SKILL_BAD_OWNER',`Skill ${id} references missing owner ${skill.owner}`,{id})}
 for(const [id,b] of Object.entries(battles)){if(!Array.isArray(b.enemies)||!b.enemies.length)pushIssue(errors,'BATTLE_NO_ENEMIES',`Battle ${id} has no enemies`,{id});if(b.reward?.drop?.item&&!ITEM_DEFS[b.reward.drop.item])pushIssue(errors,'BATTLE_BAD_DROP',`Battle ${id} drops undefined item ${b.reward.drop.item}`,{id,item:b.reward.drop.item})}
 // Conservative reachability: a required completed-event condition must have a known producer.
 const producers=new Set(EVENT_DEFS.map(e=>e.id));for(const e of EVENT_DEFS)for(const fx of e.effects||[])if(fx.type==='completeEvent'&&fx.id)producers.add(fx.id);for(const legacy of knownLegacyFlags())producers.add(LEGACY_EVENT_ID?.[legacy]||legacy);
 for(const e of EVENT_DEFS)for(const c of e.when||[])if(c.eventComplete&&!producers.has(c.eventComplete))pushIssue(errors,'EVENT_UNREACHABLE_REQUIRED_EVENT',`Event ${e.id} requires event state with no producer: ${c.eventComplete}`,{id:e.id,required:c.eventComplete});
 return{ok:errors.length===0,errors,warnings,summary:{maps:Object.keys(maps).length,events:EVENT_DEFS.length,battles:Object.keys(battles).length,skills:Object.keys(SKILLS).length,items:Object.keys(ITEM_DEFS).length}}
}
function validateRuntimeState(s=state){
 const errors=[],warnings=[];if(!maps[s.map])pushIssue(errors,'STATE_BAD_MAP',`Current map ${s.map} does not exist`,{map:s.map});if(!STORY_ORDER.includes(s.story?.stage))pushIssue(errors,'STATE_BAD_STORY',`Unknown story stage ${s.story?.stage}`,{});if(!Number.isFinite(s.x)||!Number.isFinite(s.y)||s.x<0||s.y<0||s.x>=COLS||s.y>=ROWS)pushIssue(errors,'STATE_BAD_POSITION','Player position is out of bounds',{map:s.map,x:s.x,y:s.y});
 const derived=deriveAlphaStageFromMilestones(s);if(storyIndex(derived)>storyIndex(s.story.stage))pushIssue(errors,'STATE_STORY_BEHIND',`Story ${s.story.stage} is behind milestone ${derived}`,{stage:s.story.stage,derived});
 return{ok:errors.length===0,errors,warnings}
}
function runValidation(){const data=validateData(),runtime=validateRuntimeState();const result={ok:data.ok&&runtime.ok,data,runtime};if(!result.ok)GC.Log?.error('Validation failed',result);else GC.Log?.info('Validation passed',result.data.summary);return result}
GC.Validation={validateData,validateRuntimeState,runValidation,duplicates};

</script>
<script data-origin="js/systems/menu.js">
'use strict';
// Content from imported player saves must never be interpreted as menu HTML.
function escapeMenuText(value){
 return String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({
  '&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'
 })[ch])
}
function openMenu(){
 if(state.battle)return;
 const inv=Object.entries(state.inventory).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="kv"><strong>${escapeMenuText(k)}</strong><span>${escapeMenuText(v)}</span></div>`).join('');
 const levels=state.party.map(p=>`<div class="menu-character"><div class="party-head"><strong>${escapeMenuText(p.name)}　Lv.${escapeMenuText(p.level)}</strong><span>${escapeMenuText(p.job)}</span></div><div class="menu-statline"><span>HP ${p.maxHp}</span><span>MP ${p.maxMp}</span><span>攻撃 ${p.atk}</span><span>防御 ${p.def}</span><span>素早さ ${p.spd}</span></div><div class="party-sub">EXP ${p.exp}${p.level<MAX_LEVEL?` / ${expThreshold(p.level)}`:' / MAX'}</div></div>`).join('');
 $('modalTitle').textContent='冒険メニュー';
 $('modalContent').innerHTML=`<div class="menu-list">
   <div class="kv"><strong>所持金</strong><span>${escapeMenuText(state.gold)}G</span></div>
   <div class="kv"><strong>現在地</strong><span>${escapeMenuText(maps[state.map].name)}</span></div>
   <div class="kv"><strong>目的</strong><span>${escapeMenuText(state.objective)}</span></div>
   ${levels}
   <div class="menu-inventory">${inv}</div>
   <div class="menu-actions">
     <button onclick="$('modal').classList.add('hidden');save(false)">セーブ</button>
     <button onclick="$('modal').classList.add('hidden');load(false)">ロード</button>
     <button onclick="$('modal').classList.add('hidden');GC.Save.downloadPortableSave()">セーブを書き出す（PC移行用）</button>
     <button onclick="document.getElementById('portableSaveUpload').click()">セーブを読み込む（.json）</button>
     <input id="portableSaveUpload" type="file" accept=".json,application/json" style="display:none"
       onchange="$('modal').classList.add('hidden');GC.Save.readPortableSaveFile(this.files?.[0]);this.value='';">
     ${GC.Save.hasArchivedAdventure()?`<button onclick="$('modal').classList.add('hidden');GC.Save.restoreArchivedAdventure()">以前の冒険を復旧</button>`:''}
     ${GC.Save.hasQuarantinedSaves()?`<button onclick="$('modal').classList.add('hidden');GC.Save.downloadQuarantinedSaves()">破損セーブの元データを書き出す</button>`:''}
     <button class="menu-danger" onclick="$('modal').classList.add('hidden');restart()">最初から</button>
   </div>
 </div>`;
 $('modal').classList.remove('hidden')
}
GC.Menu={openMenu};

</script>
<script data-origin="js/dev/developer.js">
'use strict';
const DEV_SNAPSHOT_KEY='gray-crown-dev-snapshots-v1';
const DEV_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS=Object.freeze({encounters:true,invincible:false,instantVictory:false,moveDelay:88,showCollision:false,showNpcCoords:false,showPlayerCoords:false,showMapId:false,showEventTriggers:false});
const DEV_STATE={open:false,tainted:false,lastEvent:null,settings:{...DEV_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS}};
const DEV_STAGE_LOCATION=Object.freeze({
 [STORY_STAGES.VILLAGE]:['village',12,12,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.APPOINTED]:['village',11,1,'up'],
 [STORY_STAGES.ROAD]:['road',11,13,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.FIRST_BATTLE]:['road',11,6,'up'],
 [STORY_STAGES.CAPITAL_APPROACH]:['northroad',11,13,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.CAPITAL]:['capital',11,13,'up'],
 [STORY_STAGES.CEREMONY]:['capital',11,10,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.WHITE_STAG]:['capitalinn',11,11,'up'],
 [STORY_STAGES.ALPHA_COMPLETE]:['capitalinn',11,11,'up'],
 [STORY_STAGES.ASH_ROAD_ORDER]:['capital',11,1,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.ASH_ROAD]:['ashroad',11,13,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.ASH_ROAD_COMPLETE]:['ashroad',11,0,'up'],
 [STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_ARRIVAL]:['frontier',11,13,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_CRISIS]:['frontier',7,10,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_BATTLE_WON]:['frontier',11,6,'down'],[STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_COMPLETE]:['frontier',9,8,'up'],
 [STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_AFTERMATH]:['frontier',9,8,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_INVESTIGATION]:['frontier',11,1,'up'],[STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_DISCOVERY]:['frontierfield',16,6,'right'],[STORY_STAGES.FRONTIER_SECOND_COMPLETE]:['frontier',9,8,'up']
});
function devEl(id){return $(id)}
function setOptions(el,items,selected=null){if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=items.map(([v,l])=>`<option value="${String(v).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}">${l}</option>`).join('');if(selected!=null)el.value=selected}
function markTainted(reason='Developer state mutation'){DEV_STATE.tainted=true;GC.Log?.warn(reason);refresh()}
function clearTaint(){DEV_STATE.tainted=false;refresh()}
function isStateTainted(){return DEV_STATE.tainted}
function noteEvent(id){if(id)DEV_STATE.lastEvent=id;refresh()}
function conditionExplanation(c,context={}){
 let pass=true,label='unknown condition';
 if(c.eventComplete){pass=isEventComplete(c.eventComplete);label=`event ${c.eventComplete} complete`}
 else if(c.eventIncomplete){pass=!isEventComplete(c.eventIncomplete);label=`event ${c.eventIncomplete} incomplete`}
 else if(c.storyIs){pass=state.story.stage===c.storyIs;label=`story == ${c.storyIs}`}
 else if(c.storyAtLeast){pass=storyAtLeast(c.storyAtLeast);label=`story >= ${c.storyAtLeast}`}
 else if(c.worldSwitchTruthy){pass=!!state.world.switches[c.worldSwitchTruthy];label=`switch ${c.worldSwitchTruthy} = true`}
 else if(c.worldSwitchFalsy){pass=!state.world.switches[c.worldSwitchFalsy];label=`switch ${c.worldSwitchFalsy} = false`}
 else if(c.visited){pass=hasVisited(c.visited);label=`visited ${c.visited}`}
 else if(c.notVisited){pass=!hasVisited(c.notVisited);label=`not visited ${c.notVisited}`}
 else if(c.contextEquals){pass=context[c.contextEquals.key]===c.contextEquals.value;label=`context.${c.contextEquals.key} == ${c.contextEquals.value}`}
 return{pass,label}
}
function inspectEvent(def){
 const context={map:state.map},tr=def.trigger||{};const checks=[];
 if(tr.map)checks.push({pass:tr.map===state.map,label:`map == ${tr.map}`});
 for(const c of def.when||[])checks.push(conditionExplanation(c,context));
 const available=checks.every(c=>c.pass);return{def,available,checks}
}
function renderStoryInspector(){const box=devEl('devStoryInspector');if(!box)return;const candidates=EVENT_DEFS.filter(e=>!e.trigger?.map||e.trigger.map===state.map||e.id.startsWith('alpha.')).map(inspectEvent);box.innerHTML=candidates.map(x=>`<div class="dev-story-event ${x.available?'available':'blocked'}"><b>${x.def.id} — ${x.available?'EVENT AVAILABLE':'BLOCKED'}</b>${x.checks.length?x.checks.map(c=>`<div class="dev-cond ${c.pass?'pass':'fail'}">${c.pass?'PASS':'FAIL'} · ${c.label}</div>`).join(''):'<div class="dev-cond pass">PASS · no conditions</div>'}</div>`).join('')||'<em>イベントなし</em>'}
function renderFlags(){const box=devEl('devActiveFlags');if(!box)return;const legacy=knownLegacyFlags().sort().map(k=>`flag:${k} = ${structuredCondition(k)}`);const switches=Object.entries(state.world.switches||{}).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)).map(([k,v])=>`switch:${k} = ${!!v}`);const eventIds=[...new Set([...EVENT_DEFS.map(e=>e.id),...Object.keys(state.events.completed||{})])].sort();const events=eventIds.map(k=>`one-shot:${k} = ${isEventComplete(k)}`);box.textContent=['[Story/World compatibility flags]',...legacy,'','[World switches]',...(switches.length?switches:['(none)']),'','[One-shot events]',...events].join('\n')}
function renderRuntime(){const box=devEl('devRuntime');if(!box)return;const p=state.party[0];box.textContent=[`Map: ${state.map}  (${state.x},${state.y}) dir=${state.dir}`,`Story: ${state.story.stage}`,`Chapter: ${state.story.chapter}`,`Objective: ${state.story.objective}`,`Karen: Lv.${p.level} HP ${p.hp}/${p.maxHp} MP ${p.mp}/${p.maxMp}`,`Gold: ${state.gold}`,`BGM: ${AUDIO.theme} / sound=${AUDIO.enabled}`,`Last Event: ${DEV_STATE.lastEvent||'-'}`,`Save Schema: ${SAVE_SCHEMA}`,`State: ${DEV_STATE.tainted?'DEV TAINTED — normal save protected':'clean'}`].join('\n')}
function renderLogs(){const box=devEl('devLog');if(!box)return;box.textContent=(GC.Log?.get()?.slice(-60)||[]).map(e=>`${e.time.slice(11,19)} [${e.type}] ${e.message}${e.data?' '+JSON.stringify(e.data):''}`).join('\n')||'(log empty)';box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight}
function refreshSnapshots(){const el=devEl('devSnapshotSelect');if(!el)return;const snaps=readSnapshots();setOptions(el,snaps.map(s=>[s.id,`${s.name} · ${new Date(s.created).toLocaleString()}`]),el.value)}
function syncPlayerInputs(){const sel=devEl('devHeroSelect');if(!sel)return;const p=state.party.find(x=>x.id===sel.value)||state.party[0];sel.value=p.id;devEl('devLevel').value=p.level;devEl('devExp').value=p.exp;devEl('devHp').value=p.hp;devEl('devMp').value=p.mp;devEl('devGold').value=state.gold}
function refresh(){if(!DEV_STATE.open)return;renderRuntime();renderStoryInspector();renderFlags();renderLogs();syncPlayerInputs();refreshSnapshots()}
function toggle(force){DEV_STATE.open=force===undefined?!DEV_STATE.open:!!force;devEl('developerPanel')?.classList.toggle('hidden',!DEV_STATE.open);if(DEV_STATE.open){populateStaticControls();refresh()}else canvas?.focus()}
function populateStaticControls(){
 setOptions(devEl('devStoryStage'),STORY_ORDER.map(s=>[s,`${s} · ${STORY_FLOW[s]?.objective||''}`]),state.story.stage);
 setOptions(devEl('devFlagSelect'),[...new Set([...knownLegacyFlags(),...Object.keys(state.world.switches||{})])].sort().map(k=>[k,k]),devEl('devFlagSelect')?.value);
 setOptions(devEl('devMapSelect'),Object.keys(maps).sort().map(id=>[id,`${id} · ${maps[id].name}`]),state.map);
 setOptions(devEl('devEventSelect'),EVENT_DEFS.map(e=>[e.id,e.id]),devEl('devEventSelect')?.value);
 setOptions(devEl('devBattleSelect'),Object.keys(battles).map(id=>[id,`${id} · ${battles[id].name}`]),devEl('devBattleSelect')?.value);
 setOptions(devEl('devHeroSelect'),state.party.map(p=>[p.id,p.name]),devEl('devHeroSelect')?.value||state.party[0].id);
 setOptions(devEl('devItemSelect'),Object.keys(ITEM_DEFS).map(id=>[id,id]),devEl('devItemSelect')?.value);
 devEl('devEncounters').checked=DEV_STATE.settings.encounters;devEl('devInvincible').checked=DEV_STATE.settings.invincible;devEl('devInstantVictory').checked=DEV_STATE.settings.instantVictory;devEl('devMoveDelay').value=DEV_STATE.settings.moveDelay;devEl('devShowCollision').checked=DEV_STATE.settings.showCollision;devEl('devShowNpcCoords').checked=DEV_STATE.settings.showNpcCoords;devEl('devShowPlayerCoords').checked=DEV_STATE.settings.showPlayerCoords;devEl('devShowMapId').checked=DEV_STATE.settings.showMapId
}
function safeSpawn(mapId){const preferred=INTERIOR_MAPS.includes(mapId)?[11,11]:[11,13];return nearestSafeTile(mapId,preferred[0],preferred[1])}
function warp(mapId){if(!maps[mapId])return false;const [x,y]=safeSpawn(mapId);setMap(mapId,x,y,'up',[[x+1,y],[x+2,y],[x+3,y]]);markTainted('Developer Map Warp');refresh();return true}
function applyStoryStage(stage){if(!STORY_ORDER.includes(stage))return false;if(typeof confirm==='function'&&!confirm(`Story Stateを ${stage} へ安全適用します。Developer状態になります。`))return false;applyCanonicalAlphaStage(state,stage);const loc=DEV_STAGE_LOCATION[stage];if(loc){const [map,x,y,dir]=loc,sp=nearestSafeTile(map,x,y);setMap(map,sp[0],sp[1],dir,[[sp[0]+1,sp[1]],[sp[0]+2,sp[1]],[sp[0]+3,sp[1]]])}markTainted('Developer Story State change');renderHud();draw();refresh();return true}
function applyFlag(name,value){if(!name)return false;setStructuredCondition(name,!!value);reconcileStoryState(state);markTainted('Developer Flag change: '+name);renderHud();draw();refresh();return true}
function launchEvent(id,force=false){const def=EVENT_DEFS.find(e=>e.id===id);if(!def)return false;if(!force){const inspection=inspectEvent(def);if(!inspection.available){GC.Log?.warn('Developer event blocked by conditions',{id,checks:inspection.checks});refresh();return false}}markTainted('Developer Event Launcher: '+id);noteEvent(id);playEventDialogue(def,()=>{applyEventEffects(def,{map:state.map,developer:true,forced:force});refresh()});return true}
function launchBattle(id){if(!battles[id]||state.battle)return false;markTainted('Developer Battle Launcher: '+id);startBattle(id,false);refresh();return true}
function launchKarenPrototype(mode='portraitOn',renderMode='pixel48-full'){if(GC.Cinematic?.isActive?.())return false;if(typeof ALPHA_SESSION!=='undefined'&&!ALPHA_SESSION.started)hideTitle();markTainted('Developer Karen Pixel Acting Prototype');toggle(false);GC.Cinematic?.startKarenPrototype?.({mode,renderMode}).then(()=>refresh());return true}
function applyPlayerDebug(){const hero=state.party.find(p=>p.id===devEl('devHeroSelect').value)||state.party[0],level=Math.max(1,Math.min(MAX_LEVEL,Number(devEl('devLevel').value)||hero.level)),stats=calculateBaseStatsAtLevel(hero.id,level);hero.level=level;hero.exp=Math.max(0,Number(devEl('devExp').value)||0);if(stats){hero.maxHp=stats.maxHp;hero.maxMp=stats.maxMp;hero.atk=stats.atk;hero.def=stats.def;hero.spd=stats.spd}hero.hp=Math.max(0,Math.min(hero.maxHp,Number(devEl('devHp').value)||0));hero.mp=Math.max(0,Math.min(hero.maxMp,Number(devEl('devMp').value)||0));state.gold=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(devEl('devGold').value)||0));markTainted('Developer Player Debug');renderHud();draw();refresh()}
function applyItemDebug(){const id=devEl('devItemSelect').value;if(!ITEM_DEFS[id])return;state.inventory[id]=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(devEl('devItemQty').value)||0));markTainted('Developer Item Debug: '+id);renderHud();refresh()}
function readSnapshots(){try{const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(DEV_SNAPSHOT_KEY)||'[]');return Array.isArray(v)?v:[]}catch{return[]}}
function writeSnapshots(v){localStorage.setItem(DEV_SNAPSHOT_KEY,JSON.stringify(v.slice(-20)))}
function saveSnapshot(name='checkpoint'){if(transientUiActive()){GC.Log?.warn('Debug Snapshot rejected during transient state');refresh();return false}const list=readSnapshots(),id='snap-'+Date.now();list.push({id,name:String(name||'checkpoint'),created:Date.now(),payload:serializeSave()});writeSnapshots(list);GC.Log?.info('Debug Snapshot Save',{id,name});refresh();return true}
function loadSnapshot(id){const snap=readSnapshots().find(s=>s.id===id);if(!snap)return false;const next=migrateLoaded(snap.payload);clearTransientPanels();replaceState(next);VISUAL.map=null;setMusic(mapMusicTheme(state.map));if(typeof ALPHA_SESSION!=='undefined'&&!ALPHA_SESSION.started)hideTitle();markTainted('Debug Snapshot Restore');GC.Log?.info('Debug Snapshot Load',{id,name:snap.name});renderHud();draw();refresh();return true}
function deleteSnapshot(id){writeSnapshots(readSnapshots().filter(s=>s.id!==id));refresh()}
function resetOptions(){DEV_STATE.settings={...DEV_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS};populateStaticControls();draw();refresh()}
function drawWorldOverlay(c){const st=DEV_STATE.settings,m=maps[state.map];if(st.showCollision){c.save();c.lineWidth=1;for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++)for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){const blocked=['T','H','S','W','R','K','Z'].includes(m.tiles[y][x])||m.npcs.some(n=>npcVisible(n)&&n.x===x&&n.y===y)||m.objects.some(o=>o.x===x&&o.y===y&&!objectCleared(o.id)&&!['gate','exit','northExit','southExit','roadSign','milestone','banner','rations'].includes(o.id));if(blocked){c.fillStyle='rgba(220,65,65,.15)';c.fillRect(x*TILE,y*TILE,TILE,TILE);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,80,80,.5)';c.strokeRect(x*TILE+.5,y*TILE+.5,TILE-1,TILE-1)}}c.restore()}if(st.showNpcCoords){c.save();c.font='9px monospace';c.fillStyle='#ffe39a';for(const n of m.npcs.filter(npcVisible))c.fillText(`${n.id} ${n.x},${n.y}`,n.x*TILE,n.y*TILE-2);c.restore()}if(st.showPlayerCoords){c.save();c.font='bold 10px monospace';c.fillStyle='#fff';c.fillText(`P ${state.x},${state.y}`,state.x*TILE,state.y*TILE-5);c.restore()}if(st.showMapId){c.save();c.font='bold 12px monospace';c.fillStyle='#fff';c.fillText(`MAP ${state.map}`,8,16);c.restore()}}
function bind(){
