 devEl('devClose')?.addEventListener('click',()=>toggle(false));devEl('devApplyStory')?.addEventListener('click',()=>applyStoryStage(devEl('devStoryStage').value));devEl('devApplyFlag')?.addEventListener('click',()=>applyFlag(devEl('devFlagSelect').value,devEl('devFlagValue').value==='true'));devEl('devWarp')?.addEventListener('click',()=>warp(devEl('devMapSelect').value));devEl('devEventNormal')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchEvent(devEl('devEventSelect').value,false));devEl('devEventForce')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchEvent(devEl('devEventSelect').value,true));devEl('devBattleLaunch')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchBattle(devEl('devBattleSelect').value));devEl('devApplyPlayer')?.addEventListener('click',applyPlayerDebug);devEl('devApplyItem')?.addEventListener('click',applyItemDebug);devEl('devHeroSelect')?.addEventListener('change',syncPlayerInputs);
 const bindSetting=(id,key,kind='check')=>devEl(id)?.addEventListener('change',e=>{DEV_STATE.settings[key]=kind==='number'?Math.max(20,Math.min(250,Number(e.target.value)||88)):!!e.target.checked;draw();refresh()});bindSetting('devEncounters','encounters');bindSetting('devInvincible','invincible');bindSetting('devInstantVictory','instantVictory');bindSetting('devMoveDelay','moveDelay','number');bindSetting('devShowCollision','showCollision');bindSetting('devShowNpcCoords','showNpcCoords');bindSetting('devShowPlayerCoords','showPlayerCoords');bindSetting('devShowMapId','showMapId');
 devEl('devKaren48Portrait')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('portraitOn','pixel48-full'));devEl('devKaren48NoPortrait')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('portraitOff','pixel48-full'));devEl('devKaren48Motion')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('motionOnly','pixel48-full'));devEl('devKaren44Portrait')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('portraitOn','pixel48-medium'));devEl('devKaren44NoPortrait')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('portraitOff','pixel48-medium'));devEl('devKaren44Motion')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('motionOnly','pixel48-medium'));devEl('devKaren41Motion')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('motionOnly','pixel48-compact'));devEl('devKaren32Baseline')?.addEventListener('click',()=>launchKarenPrototype('motionOnly','legacy32'));
 devEl('devSnapshotSave')?.addEventListener('click',()=>saveSnapshot(devEl('devSnapshotName').value));devEl('devSnapshotLoad')?.addEventListener('click',()=>loadSnapshot(devEl('devSnapshotSelect').value));devEl('devSnapshotDelete')?.addEventListener('click',()=>deleteSnapshot(devEl('devSnapshotSelect').value));devEl('devValidate')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const r=runValidation();devEl('devValidation').textContent=JSON.stringify(r,null,2);refresh()});devEl('devClearLog')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{GC.Log?.clear();refresh()});devEl('devResetOptions')?.addEventListener('click',resetOptions)
}
bind();
GC.Dev={state:DEV_STATE,settings:DEV_STATE.settings,getSettings:()=>DEV_STATE.settings,toggle,refresh,markTainted,clearTaint,isStateTainted,noteEvent,inspectEvent,applyStoryStage,applyFlag,warp,launchEvent,launchBattle,launchKarenPrototype,saveSnapshot,loadSnapshot,deleteSnapshot,readSnapshots,drawWorldOverlay,resetOptions};
// Keep settings reference stable for systems that read GC.Dev.settings directly.
Object.defineProperty(GC.Dev,'settings',{get:()=>DEV_STATE.settings});

</script>
<script data-origin="js/game.js">
'use strict';
const ALPHA_SESSION={started:false};
function updateTitleContinue(){const b=$('titleContinue');if(b)b.disabled=!GC.Save.hasUsableStoredAdventure()}
function hideTitle(){const t=$('titleScreen');if(t)t.classList.add('hidden');ALPHA_SESSION.started=true;canvas.focus()}
function showAlphaIntro(){say('ナレーション','戦争が始まって四年。|王都から遠い[[リュネ村]]にも、食料不足の影響が出始めていた。<br><br>今日は子どもたちも大人たちも、いつも通り村で暮らしている。||広場には王国使者がいる。先に話しても、寄り道をしてもいい。')}
function beginAlphaNewGame(clearSave=false){resetState();GC.Dev?.clearTaint?.();if(clearSave){localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY)}$('battlePanel').classList.add('hidden');$('levelUpPanel').classList.add('hidden');VISUAL.map=null;setMusic(mapMusicTheme(state.map));renderHud();draw();hideTitle();GC.Log?.info('New Game');showAlphaIntro();updateTitleContinue()}
function startNewGameSafely(){
 // A fresh game can eventually replace the only manual save. Ask first,
 // then preserve the previous adventure in a third non-rotating save slot.
 // No story, party stats or original sprite source is changed.
 let existing=false,olderArchive=false;
 try{
  existing=!!(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)||localStorage.getItem(SAVE_BACKUP_KEY));
  olderArchive=!!localStorage.getItem(GC.Save.SAVE_ARCHIVE_KEY)
 }catch(e){
  GC.Log?.error('Save storage inaccessible',{error:String(e)});
  alert('セーブの保存領域を確認できません。データ保護のため新規開始を中止しました。');
  return false
 }
 if(existing){
  const validStored=GC.Save.hasUsableStoredAdventure();
  const overwrite=!validStored
   ?'既存の保存形式に破損または未対応のデータがあります。元データを消さずに保管して新しい冒険を始める操作です。'
   :olderArchive?'前回の復旧用データは、最後に手動保存した内容に置き換わります。'
   :'最後に手動保存した冒険を復旧用に保管します。';
  if(!confirm('新しい冒険を始めますか？\n未保存の進行は失われます。\n'+overwrite+'\n大切なデータはメニューからJSON書き出しも行ってください。'))return false;
  if(!GC.Save.archiveBeforeNewGame()){
   if(validStored){
    alert('以前の冒険を保管できませんでした。データを守るため新規開始を中止しました。');
    return false
   }
   // The user may still want to play after both save slots are damaged.
   // Quarantine *exact original bytes*, never delete/normalize them silently.
   if(!confirm('通常のセーブとバックアップを復旧できません。破損データを別に保管し、新しい冒険を始めますか？\n後からメニューで元データを書き出せます。'))return false;
   if(!GC.Save.quarantineCorruptSavesBeforeNewGame()){
    alert('破損データの保管に失敗したため、新規開始を中止しました。');
    return false
   }
  }
 }
 beginAlphaNewGame(false);
 return true
}
function continueAlphaFromTitle(){if(!load(true)){updateTitleContinue();return}hideTitle();say('システム','セーブ地点から再開します。')}
function primaryAction(){if(!ALPHA_SESSION.started)return;if(!$('dialogueBox').classList.contains('hidden')){if(dialogueTyping()){finishDialogueTyping();return}if(dialogueChoices.length)activateDialogueChoice();else if(dialogueContinue){const fn=dialogueContinue;closeDialogue(false);fn()}else closeDialogue();return}interact()}
function handleKeydown(e){if(e.key==='F2'){e.preventDefault();GC.Dev?.toggle?.();return}ensureAudio();if(!ALPHA_SESSION.started){if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&!e.repeat){const active=document.activeElement;if(active&&['titleNewGame','titleContinue'].includes(active.id))return;e.preventDefault();startNewGameSafely()}return}if($('levelUpPanel')&&!$('levelUpPanel').classList.contains('hidden')){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();$('levelUpContinue').click()}return}if(!$('modal').classList.contains('hidden')){if(e.key==='Escape')$('modal').classList.add('hidden');return}const k=e.key.toLowerCase();if(state.battle)return;if(isInputLocked()&&$('dialogueBox').classList.contains('hidden'))return;if(!$('dialogueBox').classList.contains('hidden')){if(dialogueTyping()){if(k==='enter'||k===' '){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)finishDialogueTyping()}return}if(dialogueChoices.length&&['arrowleft','arrowup','a','w'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();dialogueChoiceIndex=(dialogueChoiceIndex-1+dialogueChoices.length)%dialogueChoices.length;refreshChoiceHighlight();return}if(dialogueChoices.length&&['arrowright','arrowdown','d','s'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();dialogueChoiceIndex=(dialogueChoiceIndex+1)%dialogueChoices.length;refreshChoiceHighlight();return}if(k==='enter'||k===' '){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)primaryAction();return}if(k==='escape'&&!dialogueChoices.length){e.preventDefault();closeDialogue();return}return}if(['arrowup','w'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();move('up')}else if(['arrowdown','s'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();move('down')}else if(['arrowleft','a'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();move('left')}else if(['arrowright','d'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();move('right')}else if(k==='enter'||k===' '){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)primaryAction()}else if(k==='m')openMenu()}
function bindAppControls(){document.addEventListener('keydown',handleKeydown);$('titleNewGame')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ensureAudio();startNewGameSafely()});$('titleContinue')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ensureAudio();continueAlphaFromTitle()});document.querySelectorAll('[data-move]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>move(b.dataset.move)));$('mobileAct')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ensureAudio();primaryAction()});$('btnSound')?.addEventListener('click',toggleSound);$('btnSave')?.addEventListener('click',()=>save(false));$('btnLoad')?.addEventListener('click',()=>load(false));$('btnRestart')?.addEventListener('click',restart);$('modalClose')?.addEventListener('click',()=>$('modal').classList.add('hidden'));$('modal')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===$('modal'))$('modal').classList.add('hidden')});canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>canvas.focus())}
function boot(){bindAppControls();const validation=GC.Validation?.runValidation?.();if(validation&&!validation.ok)GC.Log?.error('Boot validation failed',validation);renderHud();draw();updateTitleContinue();GC.Log?.info('Boot complete')}
boot();
GC.App={ALPHA_SESSION,updateTitleContinue,hideTitle,showAlphaIntro,beginAlphaNewGame,continueAlphaFromTitle,startNewGameSafely,primaryAction,handleKeydown,boot};

</script>
